scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Best Cooler Material^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation: 我为你准备了一个名为^880088最佳冷却材料^000000的请求。你可以打开^990099任务窗口^000000查看请求详情以及汇报对象。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
The Supply Manager has urgently requested paint to use on building maintenance throughout the city.
scripts.translation:
[普拉]
补给管理员紧急请求用于全城建筑维护的油漆。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
He can make enough paint by using the Fluorescent Liquid obtained from Aqua Elementals. Please bring back 26 containers of it.
scripts.translation:
[普拉]
他可以使用从水元素身上获得的荧光色的液体制作足够的油漆。请带回26瓶。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Best Paint^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation: 我为你准备了一个名为^880088最佳油漆^000000的请求。你可以打开^990099任务窗口^000000查看请求详情以及汇报对象。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
The valuable interior water bottle in the minister's room is broken. They won't be able to find who did it because there are so many visitors every day.
scripts.translation:
[普拉]
大臣房间里珍贵的水瓶坏了。因为每天都有很多访客，他们无法找出是谁弄坏的。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
Can you please bring me this valuable item from Aqua Elemental? I only need 1.
scripts.translation:
[普拉]
请帮我从水元素身上带回这件贵重物品。我只需要1个。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Rare Valuable^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation: 我为你准备了一个名为^880088稀有贵重品^000000的请求。你可以打开^990099任务窗口^000000查看请求详情以及汇报对象。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
Lining supplies for armor for the Guards are all out.
scripts.translation:
[普拉]
用于卫兵铠甲内衬的补给品已经用完了。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
The scale shell from Naga are perfect lining material. Please bring back 18 of them.
scripts.translation:
[普拉]
那迦的鳞片皮肤是完美的内衬材料。请带回18个。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Armory Material^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation: 我为你准备了一个名为^880088军械材料^000000的请求。你可以打开^990099任务窗口^000000查看请求详情以及汇报对象。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
I got you a request named lining material for armor supplied to the guard commanders. They are different from ordinary lining.
scripts.translation:
[普拉]
我为你准备了一个关于卫兵指挥官铠甲内衬材料的请求。它们与普通内衬不同。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
Please bring me 11 shining scales of Naga. I don't think it will be much trouble for you.
scripts.translation:
[普拉]
请帮我带回11个那迦的发亮鳞片。我想这对您来说不会太麻烦。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Advanced Armory Material^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation: 我为你准备了一个名为^880088高级军械材料^000000的请求。你可以打开^990099任务窗口^000000查看请求详情以及汇报对象。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of items. Let's try again after you reduce the number of items.
scripts.translation: 你的物品种类太多了。请在减少物品数量后再试一次。

scripts.text: Cannot proceed because the weight of your items is too heavy. Let's try again after you get rid of some weight.
scripts.translation: 由于您的物品重量过重，无法继续。请在减轻负重后再试一次。
由于您的物品重量过重，无法继续。请在减轻负重后再试一次。

scripts.text: I don't feel confident in talking since you wouldn't understand anything.
scripts.translation: 既然你听不懂，我也不敢多说了。

scripts.text: Sapha keeps a distance from you even when you try to talk. Looks like he called on Guard Galten. Time to go.
scripts.translation: 萨法即使你想和他说话，他也保持着距离。看来他叫来了卫兵加尔滕。该走了。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
It is pretty embarassing that you are looking for a request with your level, you know that?
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
以您的等级寻找请求，这有点尴尬，您知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
Calculate your request activities with the ^990099Supply Dept. 2 Manager^000000 at Operations and then come back.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
请前往运营部与^990099补给二部主管^000000计算您的请求活动，然后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
I don't have any requests for you now. Report back to the ^990099Supply Dept. 2 Manager^000000 at Operations after you complete all requests.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
我现在没有给您的请求。完成所有请求后，请向运营部的^990099补给二部主管^000000汇报。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
Welcome.
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
欢迎光临。
您来这里有什么事吗？

scripts.text: Please explain the request to me.
scripts.translation: 请向我解释任务。

scripts.text: Please give me a request.
scripts.translation: 请给我一个任务。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
Pura will explain the detail about the supply job. I'm soooo busy as you can see.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
普拉会向您解释补给工作的详情。如您所见，我忙得不可开交。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
I just got a request. It's good that none of us wasted time.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
我刚收到一个请求。幸好我们没有浪费时间。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
It's time to repair the trumpets for Mine supervisors.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
是时候修理米内主管们的号角了。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
Because those trumpets are necessary to control the miners. The mystic horn from Cornus is the perfect trumpet material, please get 5 pieces of them.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
因为这些号角对于控制矿工来说是必需的。飞马的魔力之角是完美的号角材料，请获取5个。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Supervisor's Tool^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation: 我为你准备了一个名为^880088主管的工具^000000的请求。你可以打开^990099任务窗口^000000查看请求详情以及汇报对象。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
It seems that there isn't enough amount of fur which is for the adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
似乎用于冒险者的皮毛数量不足。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
It will be necessary to get some fur from Tatacho. 21 lumps will be enough.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
需要从哒哒乔身上获取一些皮毛。21团就足够了。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Preparation for Heating^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation: 我为你准备了一个名为^880088供暖准备^000000的请求。你可以打开^990099任务窗口^000000查看请求详情以及汇报对象。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
There was a request from the pub to collect 27 bug legs.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
酒馆那边有一个请求，需要收集27个昆虫后脚。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
They don't wanna reveal the reason why they need them. Anyway, thank you.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
他们不想透露需要这些的原因。总之，谢谢你了。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Suspicious Food^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation: 我为你准备了一个名为^880088可疑的食物^000000的请求。你可以打开^990099任务窗口^000000查看请求详情以及汇报对象。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
Zargon is very popular among the residents here. It's a beautiful, round shaped ball and can be used as a adhesive when its powder is mixed with water.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
刹勒空结晶在这里的居民中很受欢迎。它是一种美丽的圆球，将其粉末与水混合后可用作粘合剂。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
Heard that it's very common material from the adventurers' land. Would you get some? It will be enough with 26 Zargons.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
听说在冒险者的土地上这是一种很常见的材料。能去弄一些吗？26个刹勒空结晶就足够了。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Useful Material^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation: 我为你准备了一个名为^880088有用的材料^000000的请求。你可以打开^990099任务窗口^000000查看请求详情以及汇报对象。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
There is a request which is to find a material to be used for every quarter's building repair work.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
有一个请求，需要寻找用于每季度建筑修缮工作的材料。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
Please get 13 Solid shells which can be obtained from Centipede and Centipede Larva. It will be very useful for the repair work.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
请从变异蜈蚣和变异蜈蚣幼虫身上获取13个坚硬外皮。这对修缮工作非常有用。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Essential Material for Construction^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation: 我为你准备了一个名为^880088建筑必备材料^000000的请求。你可以打开^990099任务窗口^000000查看请求详情以及汇报对象。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
There is a request which is to find a material to be used for every quarter's building repair work.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
有一个请求，需要寻找用于每季度建筑修缮工作的材料。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
You need to get 16 Strong vines which can be got from nepenthes. It's a vital material for building repair work.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
你需要从猪笼草身上获取16个结实的藤。这是建筑修缮工作的关键材料。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Essential Material for Construction 2^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation: 我为你准备了一个名为^880088建筑必备材料 2^000000的请求。你可以打开^990099任务窗口^000000查看请求详情以及汇报对象。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
The guard need many sharp leaves for a decoration reason. Some other adventurers started searching them.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
卫兵们需要很多锋利的叶子用于装饰。其他一些冒险者已经开始寻找了。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
They need pretty many quantity of the leaves so they want 26 sharp leaves from you. I know it's hard. Wish you good luck!
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
他们需要的叶子数量相当多，所以希望你提供26片锋利的叶子。我知道这很难。祝你好运！

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Decoration arrangement^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation: 我为你准备了一个名为^880088装饰布置^000000的请求。你可以打开^990099任务窗口^000000查看请求详情以及汇报对象。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
The pub owner is in trouble due to many adventurers from outside.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
由于许多外地冒险者的到来，酒馆老板遇到了麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
He wishes to have an utensil which can be used simply and instantly, something like a wide leaf.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
他希望能有一种可以简单、即时使用的器具，比如宽大的叶子。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Instant Receptacle^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation: 我为你准备了一个名为^880088即时容器^000000的请求。你可以打开^990099任务窗口^000000查看请求详情以及汇报对象。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
There have been couple of attacks in mine. It must be those Nepenthes that were trying to attack miners.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
米内发生了几次袭击事件。一定是那些试图攻击矿工的猪笼草。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
In order to make the medicine, we need 16 brown roots. Find and bring them.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
为了制作药物，我们需要16个褐色树根。请找到并带回来。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Not enough medicine^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation: 我为你准备了一个名为^880088药物不足^000000的请求。你可以打开^990099任务窗口^000000查看请求详情以及汇报对象。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
The pub owner came by and blamed and blamed about the big appetite of you guys.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
酒馆老板来过，一直抱怨你们胃口太大。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
He said he has no more stock of honey and fruits. 2 jugs of honey will be enough to soothe him.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
他说蜂蜜和水果的存货都不够了。两罐蜂蜜应该就能让他满意了。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Honey robber^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation: 我为你准备了一个名为^880088蜂蜜大盗^000000的请求。你可以打开^990099任务窗口^000000查看请求详情以及汇报对象。

scripts.text: - You can too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Doha]
What is it?
You don't look like you have any business with me.
If you don't, please leave now.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
什么事？
你看起来并不像有公事要找我。
如果没有，请现在离开。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Who is asking?
If you are in the wrong room, please leave now.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
谁在问？
如果你走错房间了，请现在离开。

scripts.text: Came to meet the inspector.
scripts.translation: 来见检查员

scripts.text: Sorry.
scripts.translation: 抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Me?
Are you the person the captain was speaking of?
What was the name...
{0}?
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
我？
你是船长提到的那个人吗？
名字是...
{0}？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Hmm.. I don't know why you were chosen but I guess they trusted you enough.
I heard you were chosen to visit El Dicastes, the capital city of Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
嗯...我不知道为什么选中了你，但我想他们足够信任你。
我听说你被选中去拜访萨法的首都——埃尔·迪卡特斯。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
I have a secret mission for you regarding this visit.
More like an order.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
关于这次拜访，我有一个秘密任务交给你。
与其说是任务，不如说是命令。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
I'm the inspector dispatched from the home country because of the report case.
We are working on investigating the truth behind the reported case.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
我是因为报告案件而从本国派遣来的检查员。
我们正在调查报告案件背后的真相。

scripts.text: Report case?
scripts.translation: 报告案件？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
You haven't heard of it?
I thought you already knew..
So you're not the one that collected the report back then?
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
你还没听说过？
我以为你已经知道了...
所以，当时收集报告的人不是你？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
When the expedition was dispatched before
there was a general report on our research results on various categories
and the messenger that was carrying this report back to home country was attacked.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
之前派遣探险队时，
有一份关于各类研究结果的总报告，
而携带这份报告回国的信使遭到了袭击。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Luckily the report wasn't stolen completely
and we did get the report after painstakingly restoring it.
The important thing is who did this.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
幸运的是，报告并没有被完全偷走，
我们费了很大劲才将其修复。
重要的是，是谁做的这件事。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
As you already know the expedition here is an alliance of 3 countries.
And we aren't all in good terms.
That is why Hibba Agip was put in charge by the captain and upper management because he isn't attached to any of the countries.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
如你所知，这里的探险队是三个国家的联盟。
而且我们之间并不和睦。
正因如此，船长和高层才让希巴·阿吉普负责，因为他不隶属于任何一个国家。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
But the important thing is which country was behind this
and why would they do such a thing when we must promote peace and cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
但重要的是，是哪个国家在幕后指使，
以及在我们必须促进和平与合作的时候，他们为什么要这么做。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
That is why I was dispatched here to investigate on.
I've come across an unexpected information during my investigation.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
所以我被派遣到这里进行调查。
在调查过程中，我意外地获得了一条信息。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Do you know the Cat Merchant?
They are also doing business nearby.
One of the Cat Merchants
spilled this information to me.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
你知道猫商人吗？
他们也在附近做生意。
其中一只猫商人
向我透露了这条信息。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
I was investigating at the location assumed to be where the attack took place
when I met a cat. Well.. I don't know what else I'm supposed to call them.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
我原本在推测袭击发生地点进行调查，
结果遇到了一只猫。嗯...我不知道该叫它什么。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
But it turns out, I was lucky to meet this cat.
Because he turned out to be a witness to the case.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
但事实证明，我很幸运遇到了这只猫。
因为它竟然是这起案件的目击者。

scripts.text: Witness!
scripts.translation: 目击者！

scripts.text: Who did it?
scripts.translation: 是谁干的？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Sigh...
He did witness the case but the description I got was...
suspicious at first.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
唉...
他确实目击了案件，但我得到的描述...
起初听起来很可疑。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Well... the cat said in his own words.
he might be one of us because he was very agile and quick.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
嗯...那只猫用他自己的话说，
他可能也是“我们”中的一员，因为他非常敏捷迅速。

scripts.text: Same race? Cat?
scripts.translation: 同族？猫？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Yes.
I heard the cat say that with my own ears.
He said he went back to the place to see if it was a lost friend of his.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
是的。
我亲耳听到那只猫这么说的。
他说他回到那个地方，想看看是不是他走散的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Hmm... my throat is soar from talking too much.
Let's continue later after I get some rest.
I think I need a cup of water.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
嗯...我说话说太多，嗓子都哑了。
让我休息一下再继续吧。
我想我需要一杯水。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Thank you.
I'm a little tired now.
I hope to see you next time.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
谢谢。
我现在有点累了。
希望下次还能见到你。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Wow.... they say this is the water melted from the snow from the snowy fields.
Very refreshing, don't you agree?
....
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
哇...听说这是雪原上的雪融化而成的水。
非常清爽，你觉得呢？
...

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Then back to the story.
So I asked why the cat thought it was his own kind.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
那么回到正题。
我问那只猫为什么觉得那是他的同类。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
He said the attacker had a wonderful tail and attractive ears.
Hard to believe.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
他说袭击者有一条漂亮的尾巴和迷人的耳朵。
难以置信。

scripts.text: It was a cat?
scripts.translation: 是只猫吗？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
No. I asked the same question.
And he said the attacker looked more like me.
Meaning humanlike to be precise.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
不。我问了同样的问题。
他说袭击者看起来更像我。
也就是说，更像人类。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Yes. A human male.
He said ^4d4dff the attacker had attractive ears and a sleek and glossary tail^000000!
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
是的。一个人类男性。
他说^4d4dff袭击者有迷人的耳朵，还有一条光滑油亮的尾巴^000000！

scripts.text: Could it be a hobby?
scripts.translation: 难道是爱好？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Are you talking about the Kitty Band that was popular in Prontera?
If a full grown male was wearing one of those... and also a tail?
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
你说的是在普隆德拉很流行的猫耳发圈吗？
如果一个成年男性戴着那个...还有一条尾巴？

scripts.text: Was he in disguise?
scripts.translation: 他在伪装吗？

scripts.text: Taste should be respected.
scripts.translation: 品味应该被尊重。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
I agree.
I think one of the countries is behind this.
I honestly think both the Sapha and Rapine won't get anything out of this.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
我同意。
我认为某个国家在幕后指使。
我真心认为萨法和拉派恩都不会从中获益。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
I guess it will only be a way of hiding you are from.
Disguised as a cat, that is!
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
我想那只是用来隐藏你的身份。
伪装成猫，就是这样！

scripts.text:
[Doha]
....................
............Of course
different tastes should be respected.

[Doha]
....Ahem.
My conclusion is
Someone disguised themselves ridiculously in order to hide where they came from!
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
....咳。
我的结论是，
有人为了隐藏自己的来历，故意进行了滑稽的伪装！

scripts.text:
[Doha]
So what we need to do now is
Finding a guy with cat ears.
But I'm not so sure he will have them on him now.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
所以我们要做的，
就是找到一个长着猫耳的人。
不过我不确定他现在身上还戴着。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
But as the Cat Merchant mentioned, we shouldn't rule out the possibility that he might be from a third party.
Then what could his motives be.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
但正如猫商人所说，
我们也不能排除他来自第三方的可能性。
那么他的动机是什么呢。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Let's start simple before it gets too complicated.
I heard you are visiting El Dicastes, the capital city of Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
在事情变得复杂之前，让我们从简单的开始。
我听说你要去萨法的首都——埃尔迪卡特斯。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Whether it is a cat or dog
Please try to collect information on a guy with animal ears.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
无论是猫耳还是狗耳，
请尽量收集关于那个长着动物耳朵的人的信息。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
I will continue on searching and investigating Manuk and Splendide from here.
I need you to investigate during your journey and also at El Dicastes.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
我会继续从这里调查马努克和辉煌领域。
你需要在旅途中以及埃尔迪卡特斯进行调查。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
This is a very important mission.
There is a delicate conflict between the three countries
and there might be a possibility of an unknown third party.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
这是一项非常重要的任务。
三个国家之间存在微妙的冲突，
而且可能存在未知的第三方。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
And why did the attacker only interfered instead of stealing the whole report.
we need to the purpose.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
而且，为什么袭击者只是干扰，而不是偷走整份报告。
我们需要查明其目的。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Please bring back some clues. Anything you come by during your journey
Please report back to me if you have anything leads.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
请带回一些线索。旅途中遇到的任何情况，
如果有任何线索，请向我汇报。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
I will investigate Manuk and Splendide.
So you will have to look for clues in El Dicastes.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
我会调查马努克和辉煌领域。
所以你需要在埃尔迪卡特斯寻找线索。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
About the guy with animal ears.
It will be a tough mission but I know you will do well.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
关于那个长着动物耳朵的人。
这会是艰难的任务，但我知道你会做得很好。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
How is the investigation going?
Please try your best.
not to break the parallel relationship between countries.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
调查进展如何？
请尽力而为，
不要破坏国家之间的平行关系。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
How is the investigation going?
Do you have any significant status?
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
调查进展如何？
你有什么重大进展吗？

scripts.text:
You share the details regarding Diel, Cheshire, Ahat and the crack of dimension.
You give him a clot of blood, shells and a magical stone as evidence.
scripts.translation:
你分享了关于迪尔、柴郡、阿哈特以及次元裂缝的细节。
你给了他一团血、贝壳和一块轮回之石碎片作为证据。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Hmm..
I actually gave the same mission to all other people heading for El Dicastes.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
嗯..
我实际上给所有前往埃尔迪卡特斯的人都派了同样的任务。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
They have all brought information based on assumptions.
Meaning your evidences are not much different from the others.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
他们都带回了基于假设的信息。
这意味着你的证据与其他人的差别不大。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
At least we found out one thing.
At least we now know that the attacker is not from the three countries of Midgard.
But this is only an assumption.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
至少我们弄清了一件事。
至少我们现在知道袭击者不是来自米德加尔特三个国家中的任何一个。
但这只是一个假设。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Details of the report will be verified by a superior authority and a schedule for the next step will be given.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
报告的细节将由上级机构核实，并给出下一步的日程。
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Please have this.
This is a reward for your services up to now.
You deserve this for the hardship you are going through in another world.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
请收下这个。
这是对你迄今为止服务的奖励。
你在另一个世界经历的艰辛，值得这份回报。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
....
Sapha and Rapine, which ever.
I have something more urgent.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
...
萨法和拉平，无论哪一个。
我有更紧急的事情要处理。

scripts.text: Can you repeat that?
scripts.translation: 你能再说一遍吗？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
..? 
I didn't say a thing.
I guess you heard wrong.
Will you leave now? Because I have to organize a report.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
..？
我什么都没说。
我想是你听错了。
你现在可以离开了吗？因为我得整理报告。

scripts.text:
You are missing evidence to submit with your report:
Clotted Bloodstain, Piece of Frozen Skin, Strange Magic Stone.
You will have to collect the items again.
scripts.translation:
你提交报告时缺少以下证据：
凝固的血痕、旗帜涂鸦、奇怪的魔力之石。
你需要重新收集这些物品。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
There won't be any changes to the current policy.
Home land will continue to review the contents of your reports.
[Doha]
All we can do for now is
do our best, right?
He says its kindly but his eyes have a get out and do your work kind of look.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
现行政策不会有任何改变。
祖国将继续审查你报告的内容。
[道哈]
我们现在能做的，
就是尽力而为，对吧？
他嘴上说着客气话，眼神却像是在说“快滚去干活”。

scripts.text: - You can too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: [Shay]
scripts.translation: [谢伊]

scripts.text:
[Shay]
.. Burman Flone.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
.. 布尔曼弗洛内。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What?
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
什么？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Boring. What is it?
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
无聊。怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Sigh... Ready to order?
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
唉... 准备好点单了吗？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Another failure?.
I'm talking to myself. Don't bother.
What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
又失败了？
我在自言自语。别管我。
你要什么？

scripts.text: Order.
scripts.translation: 点单

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Never mind.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What will it be?
I have Tropical Sograt and Vermilion on the Beach flown in from Morocc.
A bit on the expensive side though.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
你要点什么？
我有从摩洛哥空运来的热带的苏克拉特和赤色海滩。
不过价格有点贵。

scripts.text: Tropical Sorgrat - 2000z
scripts.translation: 热带的苏克拉特 - 2000 Zeny

scripts.text: Vermilion on the Beach - 2000z
scripts.translation: 赤色海滩 - 2000 Zeny

scripts.text: Anything else?
scripts.translation: 还有其他吗？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Here.. 
......Hmmm...
Nah.

[Shay]
Here is your {0}.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
这是你的{0}。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
{0} is 2000 Zeny.
What is it so expensive?
Then you try to bring it all the way here.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
{0}是2000 Zeny。
为什么这么贵？
那你试试把它从那么远的地方运过来。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
If you haven't registered at Diel yet, you better do it soon.
That is the only way to start receiving requests and guarantee your safety here.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
如果你还没在迪尔登记，最好尽快去办。
这是开始接收任务并保证你在这里安全的唯一途径。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
To avoid conflicts apart from diplomatic trouble
it is always better to respect each sides agreement.
Don't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
为了避免除了外交麻烦之外的冲突，
最好始终尊重双方的协议。
你同意吗？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Not that busy but I don't want to do it.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
虽然不忙，但我不想做。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
I don't want to talk about personal stuff.
But do you have any questions?
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
我不想谈论私事。
不过你有什么问题吗？

scripts.text: Tell me about yourself
scripts.translation: 告诉我关于你的事

scripts.text: About Sapha
scripts.translation: 关于萨法

scripts.text: About other races
scripts.translation: 关于其他种族

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Me?
.If you are asking about my name, it is written on my badge here.
It's Shay.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
我？
如果你问的是我的名字，就写在我胸前的徽章上。
是谢伊。

scripts.text: Not that
scripts.translation: 不是那个

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Hmm. Then should I tell you the story on how I settled here?
The first to apply to expedite here
where the Assassins.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
嗯。那我要不要告诉你我是怎么定居在这里的？
最早申请在这里建立前哨站的是刺客。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
I was one of them.
That is how I got to reach this place before anyone else did
And that is how the base of the expedition camp was built.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
我就是其中之一。
所以我比任何人都先到达了这个地方，
前哨站基地也是由此建成的。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
But you know.
I thought I'd return to my hometown and retire.
But El Dicastes contacted me.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
但你知道的。
我本想回到家乡退休。
但El Dicastes联系了我。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
They requested if I could open a place for us outsides to feel comfortable with.
They also were considerate enough to build it in Midgard style.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
他们请求我能否为我们在外面的人提供一个舒适的地方。
他们甚至体贴地要求按米德加尔特风格建造。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
So the framework and style,
architect was brought in..
and then I found myself managing the whole project?
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
于是框架和风格，
建筑师被请来了..
然后我发现自己竟然在管理整个项目？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
And...
that is how I got here.
I've been here ever since!
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
然后...
我就来到了这里。
从那以后我就一直待在这里！

scripts.text:
[Shay]
I don't remember what my original job was.
Little rusty on the Katar, I guess...
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
我不记得我原来的职业是什么了。
拳刃用得有点生疏了，我想...

scripts.text:
Shay suddenly has a lonely expression and sighs deeply about his situation.
Looks very tired.
scripts.translation:
谢伊突然露出寂寞的神情，为他的处境深深叹息。
看起来非常疲惫。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Sapha?
You are surrounded by Saphas.
......
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
萨法？
你周围全是萨法。
......

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What are you asking me?
Just ask any Sapha passing by.
Ask 'what are you'.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
你问我什么？
随便问一个路过的萨法。
问问“你们是什么”。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Other races?
Talking about Sapha?
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
其他种族？
是在说萨法吗？

scripts.text: With cat ears.
scripts.translation: 长着猫耳

scripts.text: With butterfly wings.
scripts.translation: 长着蝴蝶翅膀

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Cat?
Are you talking about the Cat Merchant?
They are camped outside of the capital gate.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
猫？
你说的是猫商人吗？
他们在王都城门外的营地扎营。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
They even mined and fished near the expedition camp.
They are currently trying to expand their business
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
他们甚至在远征营地附近采矿和钓鱼。
他们目前正在试图扩大业务。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Well.. bigger then them?
Not sure. Haven't heard of it.
Why don't you ^4d4dffask Sapha's around here?^000000
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
嗯...比他们更大？
不确定。没听说过。
你为什么不问问^4d4dff这里的萨法？^000000

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Butterfly wings? Are you talking about Rapine?
Don't know them?
You really no nothing.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
蝴蝶翅膀？你说的是拉派恩吗？
不知道他们？
你真是什么都不懂啊。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
If you want to know about Rapine, go to Splendide.
They are rough and tough.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
如果你想知道关于拉派恩的事，去辉煌领域。
他们很粗犷强悍。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What...
I'm not that busy but don't bother me too much.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
什么...
我不算太忙，但别太烦我。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What is it now?
Any luck?
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
现在怎么了？
有进展吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm trying to organize the information I've collected.
{1}
But what should I do with the collected information?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我正在整理收集到的信息。
{1}
但我该拿这些收集到的信息怎么办？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm trying to organize the information I've collected.
But what should I do with the collected information?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我正在整理收集到的信息。
但我该拿这些收集到的信息怎么办？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm trying to organize the information I've collected.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我正在整理收集到的信息。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Moan...
[Shay]
You look lost like as if nothing makes sense anymore.
They solution is simply to ask around.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
唉...
[谢伊]
你看起来迷茫极了，好像什么都不明白。
解决办法很简单，就是到处问问。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
There are many Saphas working at the factory, drill hall, square and anywhere else.
There are the Cat Merchants outside of the castle, too.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
工厂、训练场、广场以及任何地方都有萨法在工作。
城堡外面也有猫商人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Everybody
is talking about the minister these days!
What is with this Ahat anyway.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
最近大家都在谈论大臣！
阿哈特到底是怎么回事。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
I haven't even seen the minister.
I heard many say that he is beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
我甚至没见过大臣。
我听说很多人说他很英俊。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Anyway........
Try this.
I've been working on this for some time and hope that this can go on the menu.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
总之........
试试这个。
我研究了一段时间，希望它能上菜单。

scripts.text:
- Shay places a baked pie with the base made out of carrots.
Topped with something that looks like apples or bananas.
You immediate think it is too risky to try. ?
scripts.translation:
- 谢伊拿出一个用胡萝卜做底的烤派。
上面放着看起来像苹果或香蕉的东西。
你立刻觉得尝试一下风险太大。？

scripts.text: The minced ingredient is...
scripts.translation: 碎肉馅料是...

scripts.text:
[Shay]
An apple pie.
I garnished it with bananas.
Doesn't look like it but this is an apple pie.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
苹果派。
我用香蕉做了装饰。
虽然看起来不像，但这确实是苹果派。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But why is there a carrot in a pie.
And there is no hint of apples.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
可是为什么派里会有胡萝卜呢？
而且完全闻不到苹果的味道。

scripts.text:
-Shay got all upset and threw something sticky and smelly.
The pie left Shay's palm and landed square in your face. -
scripts.translation:
- 谢伊情绪激动，扔出了某种黏糊糊且散发着异味的东西。
派从谢伊手中飞出，不偏不倚地砸在了你的脸上。 -

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Oops.. umph.. hmph...
Phew... sigh...
...........

[Shay]
S..Sorry. Aello told me to help you but..
.......
I couldn't help myself.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
对..对不起。艾洛让我帮助你，但是..
.......
我没忍住。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Ha.. there is a cat named BK among the Cat Merchants.
He might have the information you want.
... Go.. meet BK.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
哈.. 在猫商人中有一只叫BK的猫。
他可能有你想要的资讯。
... 去.. 见见BK吧。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
And if he ignores you, tell him that ^4d4dffShay's special drink will be delivered^000000.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
如果他不理你，就告诉他 ^4d4dff谢伊的特调饮品即将送达^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
You can find the Cat Merchants outside of the gate.
They seem like a small group of wanders.
You'll see their tent southeast from the gate.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
你可以在城门外的地方找到猫商人。
他们看起来像是一小群流浪者。
你会看到他们在城门东南方的帐篷。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
BK is the one that holds information around there.
He will be able to help you.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
BK是那里掌握资讯的人。
他应该能帮到你。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
You say BK said that?
So it is...
I did think Ahat was beautiful than normal.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
你是说BK那样说的？
原来如此...
我也觉得阿哈特比普通人更英俊。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
But according to the Saphas' stories I hear in this pub
they all have a different version of Ahat.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
但根据我在这家酒馆听到的萨法们的故事，
每个人对阿哈特的描述都不一样。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
But BK said Ahat isn't a Sapha?
That only means that its not the looks that is different but may be completely a different race.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
但BK说阿哈特不是萨法？
那意味着不同的可能不是外表，而是完全不同的种族。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
We can only investigate.
They say he came from the crack so let's investigate the crack.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
我们只能去调查。
听说他来自裂缝，那就去调查裂缝吧。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
But there is a crack here too?
..Too many ill-fates.
Bit sorrowful.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
但这里也有裂缝？
.. 厄运太多。
有点悲伤。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
It is always better to go to the site.
Because it is difficult to meet the minister.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
最好还是去现场看看。
因为很难见到那位大臣。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
The crack here must have been created when the crack in Morocc appeared.
If he did it.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
这里的裂缝应该是在莫洛克的裂缝出现时产生的。
如果是他造成的。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
You'll find a crack northeast from El Dicastes.
Try investigating there.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
你会在埃尔·迪卡特斯东北方发现一道裂缝。
试着在那里调查一下。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Any luck?
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
有进展吗？

scripts.text: - You show the {0} you collected from near the crack.-
scripts.translation: - 你展示了从裂缝附近收集的 {0}。 -

scripts.text:
- You do not have the item needed for the quest. Case3
If your quest item was destroyed, request help from GM.-
scripts.translation:
- 你没有任务所需的物品。Case3
如果你的任务物品被销毁，请向GM寻求帮助。 -

scripts.text:
[Shay]
.. I didn't expect this.
Then who is Ahat..?
...I smell something fishy.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
...我没想到会是这样。
那么阿哈特到底是谁？
...总觉得哪里不对劲。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
I don't know since I haven't seen Ahat in person but
we must find out what all this means.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
我还没见过阿哈特本人，所以不清楚。
但我们必须弄清楚这一切到底意味着什么。

scripts.text: Do you trust BK?
scripts.translation: 你信任BK吗？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
At least BK doesn't lie.
The BK I know never lies.
Why are these found near the crack?
Why was Ahat near the crack..
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
至少BK不会撒谎。
我认识的BK从不说谎。
为什么这些东西会在裂缝附近被发现？
为什么阿哈特会在裂缝附近...

scripts.text: Do you want to meet in person?
scripts.translation: 你想和他见面吗？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
You can't just waltz in him.
It's even harder for outsiders like us to meet him.
Hm...
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
你不能就这么直接闯进去。
对我们这些外人来说，想见他更难了。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Shay]
We can try collected exploit certifications.
Those who did great deeds get the opportunity to meet the minister.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
我们可以尝试收集功勋证明。
立下大功的人才有机会面见大臣。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
The Cat Merchants are also collected exploit certifications. They want to meet the minister in person so they can negotiate business.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
猫商人也是收集功勋证明。他们想面见大臣，以便洽谈生意。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
You can receive exploit certifications from handling requests throughout the city.
If you want to meet the minister Ahat...
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
你可以在城里处理委托来获得功勋证明。
如果你想面见大臣阿哈特...

scripts.text:
[Shay]
You'll need at least ^4d4dff3 exploit certifications^000000.
Go ^4d4dffask around in Diel^000000 for more information.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
你至少需要^4d4dff3个功勋证明^000000。
去^4d4dff迪尔^000000四处打听一下更多信息吧。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Sapha that registers adventurers in Diel.
Was his name ^4d4dffRhawyne^000000. Ask him.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
在迪尔登记冒险者的萨法。
他的名字是^4d4dff拉温^000000。去问问他。

scripts.text: Don't you have any exploit certification of Sapha?
scripts.translation: 你没有萨法的功勋证明吗？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
................
Do you think I'm that free?
I'm not the one receiving request, I'm the one that makes the requests!!
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
................
你以为我那么大方吗？
我是发布委托的人，不是接委托的人！！

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Tsk.
First, think of what you have to do.
Meet Ahat by collecting exploit certifications.
And then find doubt what is the relationship between him and the crack.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
啧。
首先，想想你要做什么。
收集功勋证明，然后面见阿哈特。
之后查明他和裂缝之间的关系。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Start with collecting exploit certifications.
You'll need at least 3 certifications to meet the minister.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
先从收集功勋证明开始吧。
你需要至少3个证明才能面见大臣。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Once you have your certifications, go make a request to meet the minister at the Adventurer's reception desk in Diel.
Rhawyne will help you.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
拿到证明后，去迪尔的冒险者接待处申请面见大臣。
拉温会帮你的。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
So.. you got permitted?
I'm also curious who this Ahat character is.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
那么...你获得许可了？
我也很好奇阿哈特到底是个什么样的人。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Good. I'll prepare some food until you come back.
I just found this amazing chocolate recipe a few days ago.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
很好。在你回来之前，我会准备一些食物。
几天前我刚发现了一个很棒的巧克力食谱。

scripts.text: Oh..no..

[Shay]
When I was in Morocc.
A colleague from the guild used to make chocolate stuff you see?
I thought it would be simple since he was making it.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
当我在莫洛克的时候。
公会里的一个同事经常做巧克力之类的东西，你懂吧？
我觉得既然他能做，应该很简单。
那么...

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Wait till you taste it.
Now, get going.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
等你尝过就知道了。
现在，快去吧。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
How was the minister?
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
大臣怎么样？

scripts.text: Strange.
scripts.translation: 奇怪。

scripts.text: ..Beautiful...

[Shay]
So.. how strange.
..was it bad or good?
No, that isn't important. Try to remember what you were there for.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
所以...很奇怪。
...是坏还是好？
不，这不重要。试着回忆一下你当时在那里是为了什么。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Huh? Really?
You can tell the beauty even if the race is different.
Do you job instead of dreaming about his appearance.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
哈？真的吗？
即使种族不同，也能看出他的美吗。
别做梦了，去做好你的工作吧。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Hmm...
Clearing the crack area?
Sounds weird.
Something smells fishy.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
嗯...
清理裂缝区域？
听起来很怪。
总觉得有些蹊跷。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Don't forget to bring back evidence.
And to pretend you are hypnotized.
Good. This is our secret.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
别忘了带证据回来。
还有，假装自己被催眠了。
很好。这是我们的秘密。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Funny how things come about.
But you really are talkative.
You are telling me everything. Tsk.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
世事真是奇妙。
不过你还真能说。
什么都告诉我了。啧。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Did you know?
There is another skillful Jarute.
Name is HesLanta.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
你知道吗？
还有另一个技艺高超的贾鲁特。
名字是赫斯兰塔。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
He sometimes come back and shares his stories.
But I think he also has a story to tell.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
他有时会回来分享他的故事。
但我觉得他也有故事要讲。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
It's only a thought but
It might be good to talk to those near Ahat too.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
这只是个想法，
但也许跟阿哈特身边的人聊聊也不错。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
How about talking to the Jarute named HesLanta?
You don't have nothing to lose, anyway.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
跟那个叫赫斯兰塔的贾鲁特聊聊怎么样？
反正你也输不起什么。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Why are you here again?
Are you working?
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
你怎么又来了？
是在工作吗？

scripts.text: Mission completed!
scripts.translation: 任务完成！

scripts.text: Came to thank you.
scripts.translation: 来感谢你的。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Really?
Good for you.
.....
Mission. Haven't heard that word for ages.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
真的吗？
真不错。
.....
任务。好久没听到这个词了。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Now go.
I'm busy.
New ingredients are coming in today.
Go now.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
现在走吧。
我很忙。
今天有新食材要进。
快走吧。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
If you are that grateful, each all my new cuisines till the last bite.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
如果你这么感激的话，就把我新做的菜吃到最后一口吧。

scripts.text: Ah, that is um...
scripts.translation: 啊，那个是...

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Huh? Get lost.
Ungrateful....
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
哈？滚开。
真没良心...

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
你想干什么？

scripts.text: Tell me about yourself
scripts.translation: 告诉我关于你的事

scripts.text: About Sapha
scripts.translation: 关于萨法

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Me?
Didn't I tell you before?
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
我？
我之前没告诉过你吗？

scripts.text: Nope..
scripts.translation: 没有...

scripts.text:
[Shay]
No, I told you my story before.
But since you have bad memory, I'll tell you again.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
不，我之前讲过我的故事。
不过既然你记性不好，我就再讲一遍。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Hmm. Then should I tell you the story on how I settled here?
The first to apply to expedite here
where the Assassins.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
嗯。那我要不要告诉你我是怎么定居在这里的？
最早申请在这里建立前哨站的是刺客。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
I was one of them.
That is how I got to reach this place before anyone else did
And that is how the base of the expedition camp was built.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
我就是其中之一。
所以我比任何人都先到达了这个地方，
前哨站基地也是由此建成的。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
But you know.
I thought I'd return to my hometown and retire.
But El Dicastes contacted me.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
但你知道的。
我本想回到家乡退休。
但El Dicastes联系了我。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
They requested if I could open a place for us outsides to feel comfortable with.
They also were considerate enough to build it in Midgard style.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
他们请求我能否为我们在外面的人提供一个舒适的地方。
他们甚至体贴地要求按米德加尔特风格建造。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
So the framework and style,
architect was brought in..
and then I found myself managing the whole project?
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
于是框架和风格，
建筑师被请来了..
然后我发现自己竟然在管理整个项目？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
And...
that is how I got here.
I've been here ever since!
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
然后...
我就来到了这里。
从那以后我就一直待在这里！

scripts.text:
[Shay]
I don't remember what my original job was.
Little rusty on the Katar, I guess...
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
我不记得我原来的职业是什么了。
拳刃用得有点生疏了，我想...

scripts.text:
Shay suddenly has a lonely expression and sighs deeply about his situation.
Looks very tired.
scripts.translation:
谢伊突然露出寂寞的神情，为他的处境深深叹息。
看起来非常疲惫。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Sapha?
You are surrounded by Saphas.
......
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
萨法？
你周围全是萨法。
......

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What are you asking me?
Just ask any Sapha passing by.
Ask 'what are you'.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
你问我什么？
随便问一个路过的萨法。
问问“你们是什么”。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What...
I'm not that busy but don't bother me too much.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
什么...
我不算太忙，但别太烦我。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What did you bring here now?
.........
What? No?
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
你现在带了什么来？
.........
什么？没有？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Tsk.... boring.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
啧...真无聊。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Why is strawberry chocolate so difficult to make?
Why is my chocolate falling apart?
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
为什么草莓巧克力这么难做？
为什么我的巧克力总是散架？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Also this chocolate pie.
How do I bake it just the right golden color?
Why can't it be white or black?
It isn't the pie that is important. It's the chocolate that is.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
还有这个巧克力派。
怎么才能烤出恰到好处的金黄色？
为什么不能是白色或者黑色？
重要的不是派，而是巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
How did my colleague make this?!
............
...Do girls like this?
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
我的同事是怎么做出这个的？！
............
...女孩们喜欢这个吗？

scripts.text: They normally do like homemade chocolate.
scripts.translation: 她们通常喜欢自制的巧克力。

scripts.text: No. only aliens.
scripts.translation: 不，只有外星人喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
I see.
So...
Are you married?
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
原来如此。
那么...
你结婚了吗？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
You're alone, right?
....
Sorry.
We're in the same boat.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
你是单身，对吧？
....
抱歉。
我们处境相同。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Suit yourself.
scripts.translation:
[谢伊]
随你便吧。

[尼特]
（乱码）

scripts.text: Cannot communicate with him.
scripts.translation: 无法与他交流。

scripts.text:
[Knit]
Welcome, human.
I'm finally used to meeting other races like you.
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
欢迎，人类。
我终于习惯见到你们这样的其他种族了。

scripts.text: Are there races other than humans?
scripts.translation: 除了人类还有其他种族吗？

scripts.text: What are you doing?
scripts.translation: 你在做什么？

scripts.text:
[Knit]
There were Rapine before you came.
And of course there are still.
But they are over the Kamidal mountains.
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
在你来之前有拉皮涅。
当然现在也有。
不过它们在卡米达尔山脉那边。

scripts.text:
[Knit]
And then the cats..
Ah, did you see the group of cats in front of the castle?
They are really soft and cuddly unlike us.
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
还有猫...
啊，你看到城堡前面那群猫了吗？
它们真的非常柔软可爱，不像我们。

scripts.text:
[Knit]
And especially their ear and tail!!
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
尤其是它们的耳朵和尾巴！！

scripts.text: Have you seen this man?
scripts.translation: 你见过这个男子吗？

scripts.text:
[Knit]
Eh? Huh?
Man? Human male?
A human male with cat ears?
Never heard such thing..
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
诶？什么？
男子？人类男性？
长着猫耳朵的人类男性？
从来没听说过这种事...

scripts.text:
[Knit]
Humans are amazing!
Didn't even think of that...!
.....
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
人类真不可思议！
我甚至都没想过...！
.....

scripts.text:
[Knit]
But they are really lovely.
Those cute cats..
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
但它们真的很可爱。
那些可爱的猫...

scripts.text:
[Knit]
But Ahat is also loveable even for a Sapha.
....if my hair is like a dry winter tree..
Ahat's hair is like new sprouts in early spring.....
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
但阿哈特即使是萨法也很可爱。
....如果我的头发像冬天的枯树...
阿哈特的头发就像早春的新芽.....

scripts.text:
[Knit]
I can't believe how he does his work for Dicastes
and still maintain such great hair.
I can almost see a glow.
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
真不敢相信他能为迪卡斯特工作
还能保持如此完美的头发。
我几乎能看到他在发光。

scripts.text:
[Knit]
Ah.....his skin is divine.
But he never comes out from his office high up in Dicastes Diel.
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
啊.....他的皮肤是神圣的。
但他从不离开迪卡斯特迪尔高处的办公室。

scripts.text:
[Knit]
But I guess it would be better for Ahat's complexion...
to stay warm and safe like a crystal bird in Diel instead of being out in the winter weather!
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
但我想，对阿哈特的肤色来说...
像迪尔里的水晶鸟一样待在温暖安全的地方，而不是在冬天的天气里，会更好！

scripts.text:
- Continues to talk about Ahat.
Don't think I'll get any more information. -
scripts.translation:
- 继续谈论阿哈特。
我想我得不到更多情报了。 -

They are really lovely.
Those cute cats..
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
它们真的很可爱。
那些可爱的猫...

scripts.text:

But Ahat is also loveable even for a Sapha.

scripts.translation:

但阿哈特即使是萨法也很可爱。
....如果我的头发像冬天的枯树...
阿哈特的头发就像早春的新芽.....

scripts.text:
[Knit]
Ah.. I'm so jealous, envious..
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
啊..我好嫉妒，好羡慕..

scripts.text:
[Knit]
As you can see, I'm taking a walk.
I should walk from time to time to prevent myself from getting stiff.
I really don't like to get stiff.
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
如你所见，我在散步。
我应该时不时走走，防止自己变得僵硬。
我真的不喜欢变得僵硬。

scripts.text:
[Knit]
Don't you think cats are amazing.
I heard from where you came from, you have pets..
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
你不觉得猫很不可思议吗。
我听说你来自的地方，你们有宠物..

scripts.text:
[Knit]
Is it okay to raise other creatures?
Do they want that?
It's a difficult issue..
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
饲养其他生物是可以的吗？
它们愿意吗？
这是个棘手的问题..

[皮奥姆]
...？
啊~！
你...你是人类吗？！

scripts.text:
[Piom]
[Piom]
Phew.. I need to rest.
Huh? You're... human!
Why are you here?
scripts.translation:
[皮奥姆]
呼..我需要休息一下。
诶？你是...人类！
你为什么在这里？

scripts.text:
[Piom]
[Piom]
As you can see, I'm taking a rest.
I like my job but it is so tiresome.
But I'm happier than when I was a Knit.
scripts.translation:
[皮奥姆]
如你所见，我在休息。
我喜欢我的工作，但它太累了。
但我比当尼特的时候更快乐。

scripts.text: Cannot communicate with him.
scripts.translation: 无法与他交流。

scripts.text: About a human with cat ears..
scripts.translation: 关于长着猫耳朵的人类..

scripts.text:
[Piom]
HAHAHAHA!!!
HAHAHAHA!!!
There are so many asking about that recently.
Is there any conflict with the Cat Merchants?
scripts.translation:
[皮奥姆]
哈哈哈哈！！
哈哈哈哈！！
最近问这个问题的人可真多。
难道你和猫商人之间有什么冲突吗？

scripts.text:
[Piom]
Haha.. ... funny.
Human with cat ears. Never heard of such thing.
But you seem to be new around here.
scripts.translation:
[皮奥姆]
哈哈... ...真有趣。
长着猫耳朵的人类？我从没听说过这种事。
不过你看起来像是刚到这里的新人。

scripts.text:
[Piom]
Don't waste your time on something ridiculous as that
That's it! I think you are the right person.
scripts.translation:
[皮奥姆]
别在这种荒唐的事情上浪费时间了。
好了！我觉得你就是我要找的人。

scripts.text:
[Piom]
The minister stays at the top of Diel
Try meeting the minister.
He is a wonderful person.
A role model to all Saphas!
scripts.translation:
[皮奥姆]
大臣住在迪尔（Diel）的顶端。
去见见大臣吧。
他是个非常好的人。
是所有萨法（Sapha）的榜样！

scripts.text:
[Piom]
You need to know about Saphas if you are staying in El Dicastes, right?
Don't spend time with a dusty Piom like me, and go meet Ahat.
You will love him.
scripts.translation:
[皮奥姆]
如果你要留在埃尔·迪卡特斯（El Dicastes），就需要了解萨法，对吧？
别在我这个满身灰尘的皮奥姆身上浪费时间了，去见见阿哈特吧。
你会喜欢他的。

scripts.text:
- Continues to talk about Ahat.
Don't think I'll get any more information. -
scripts.translation:
- 继续谈论阿哈特。
我想我得不到更多情报了。 -

scripts.text:
[Piom]
Don't follow cats around
Go and meet Ahat.
He is really beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[皮奥姆]
别跟着猫跑了。
去见见阿哈特吧。
他真的很美。

scripts.text:
[Piom]
I can't think straight.
I didn't like working through documents the Knits do.
But then Galtens have to carry heavy weapons.
scripts.translation:
[皮奥姆]
我脑子有点乱。
我不喜欢处理尼特（Knit）们做的那些文书工作。
但加尔滕（Galten）又得搬运沉重的武器。

scripts.text:
[Piom]
The last thing I did was mine and refine Bradium
and I loved it!
And to think that my work keeps everyone healthy
is rewarding.
scripts.translation:
[皮奥姆]
我最后做的工作是挖掘和精炼魔力之石，
我非常喜欢！
想到我的工作能让大家保持健康，
这就很有意义了。

scripts.text: Cannot communicate with him.
scripts.translation: 无法与他交流。

scripts.text:
[Galten]
Hmm...another peaceful day.
Hmm? Aren't you the outsider that came here awhile ago?
Have you come to see the training grounds?
scripts.translation:
[加尔滕]
嗯...又是平静的一天。
嗯？你难道就是之前来过这里的外乡人吗？
你是来看训练场的吗？

scripts.text: About a human with cat ears..
scripts.translation: 关于长着猫耳朵的人类..

scripts.text:
[Galten]
Cat ears?
Is there someone like that?
Humans are like that?
scripts.translation:
[加尔滕]
猫耳朵？
有这样的人吗？
人类都是那样的吗？

scripts.text:
[Galten]
What? No?
Then why are you looking him..
Why don't you go meet Ahat instead of wasting your time.
scripts.translation:
[加尔滕]
什么？没有？
那你为什么一直盯着他看...
别浪费时间了，去见见阿哈特吧。

scripts.text:
[Galten]
Anyone that wants to be strong
should meet Ahat.
He is a very strong Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[加尔滕]
任何想要变强的人
都应该去见见阿哈特。
他是非常强大的萨法。

scripts.text:
[Galten]
He may be a Jarute working through piles of documents
but he must be hiding his power!
scripts.translation:
[加尔滕]
他可能只是个处理堆积如山的文书的贾鲁特（Jarute），
但他一定隐藏着实力！

scripts.text:
[Galten]
Everyone says Ahat is like a delicate spring sprout
but I don't agree!
I've never seen a stronger Sapha before.
But I don't quite understand why he didn't become a Galten...
scripts.translation:
[加尔滕]
大家都说阿哈特像娇嫩的春芽，
但我不同意！
我从未见过比他更强的萨法。
但我不太明白他为什么没有成为加尔滕...

scripts.text:

Don't think I'll get any more information. -
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

Maybe he is physically strong but has a warm heart..
but you never know...
scripts.translation:
[加尔滕]
也许他身体很强壮，但内心很温柔..
但谁知道呢...

scripts.text:

You seem to be an experienced adventurer.
I would like to try you out
.. Hahahah
Just joking. I cannot fight a guest to our land.
scripts.translation:
[加尔滕]
你看起来是个经验丰富的冒险者。
我想试试你的身手
... 哈哈哈哈哈
开玩笑的。我不能攻击我们土地上的客人。

scripts.text:
[BK]
Ha. I'm the information collector of the Cat Merchants.
Ask me anything...but..
Meow.. I'm not an easy cat you see.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
哈。我是猫商人的情报收集者。
尽管问吧...但是..
喵..我可不是好惹的猫哦。

scripts.text:
[BK]
Go away, Ha
scripts.translation:
[BK]
走开，哈

scripts.text:
[BK]
Hmph...
What is it?
... Oh, a human in the capital city of Sapha.
Meow...
scripts.translation:
[BK]
哼...
什么事？
...哦，萨法首都城里的人类。
喵...

scripts.translation: 关于长猫耳的男子

scripts.text: What are you?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？

scripts.text:
[BK]
Ha, I'm BK. The Cat Merchants' infamous information collector.

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:
[BK]
我可不是好惹的猫哦。
喵...喵
喵..猫耳。哈哈哈..我听说过一些..喵..

scripts.text:
[BK]
I'm not telling you~!
scripts.translation:
[BK]
我才不告诉你呢~!

scripts.text:

Ha. I'm the information collector of the Cat Merchants.
..............
I don't give out information just to anyone.
Meow...
scripts.translation:
[BK]
哈。我是猫商团的情报收集者。
..............
我不会随便把情报告诉任何人。
喵...

scripts.text:
- BK of the Cat Merchant group is being difficult.
What did Shay tell you to do?-
scripts.translation:
- 猫商团的BK态度很不好。
谢伊让你做什么了？-

Shay's special drink will be delivered.
By Shay himself!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯。如果你不配合，
谢伊的特制饮料就会送过来。
由谢伊亲自送来！

scripts.translation:

为什么要纠缠我。
恶霸...呜呜

scripts.translation:
[BK]
好吧。我会配合。

首先，你必须告诉谢伊我配合了你。

scripts.text:

Second, we must meet the minister to expand our business.
But need exploit certifications to meet him.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
其次，我们要见大臣以拓展业务。
但需要开拓许可证才能见他。

scripts.text:
[BK]
So I'll sell my information for exploit certifications.
Tell me when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
所以我会用情报换取开拓许可证。
准备好了告诉我。

{1}.....?

scripts.translation:
[BK]
什么。你拿那个威胁我？

... So what do you want to know?

scripts.text:

Was arranged neatly.
scripts.translation:

它们被整齐地排列着。

scripts.text:

Moan... moan...
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
呻吟...呻吟...

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Moan... moan...
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
呻吟...呻吟...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you alright?

scripts.translation:
[{0}]

你看起来气色不好。需要帮忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Ah... thank you.
It's because of my injured leg.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
啊...谢谢你。
是因为我的腿受伤了。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Do you mind helping me get to the building over there?
I will feel better if I rest a little.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
你介意帮我去那边的大楼吗？
如果能休息一下，我会感觉好一些。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
I'm getting tired. Can we continue talking inside.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
我有点累了。我们进去继续聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
How is my little favor going?
We can have a chat after you are done with it.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
我的那个小忙办得怎么样了？
等你忙完我们可以聊聊天。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
{0}, the guys said they wanted to meet up together sometime.
Make sure you ckear your schedule.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
{0}，大家说想找个时间聚在一起。
记得安排好你的日程。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Moan... moan...
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
呻吟...呻吟...

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Zzz...Zzz...

[Frede]
Phew...
Thank you so much.
I'm glad I got a shot of the ^f57d7dBradium^000000 before it was too late.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
呼...
非常感谢。
幸好赶在太晚之前注射了^f57d7d魔力之石^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huff...Huff...
I'm glad that you feel better.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呼...呼...
很高兴你感觉好些了。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Oh my!! Why are you sweating so much!
You look a little pale too......
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
天哪！你怎么出这么多汗！
你的脸色看起来也有点苍白......

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, it's nothing.
I'm only a little tired, that's all.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没事，没什么。
我只是有点累而已。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Here, sit and eat this.
The cats outside gave it to me. It doesn't do much good for Saphas but I heard it's suppose to help you humans.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
来，坐下吃点这个。
外面的猫给我的。这对萨法没什么好处，但我听说这对你们人类有帮助。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But the injury on your leg doesn't look new. Why did you come out with a wounded leg?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但你腿上的伤看起来不像是新伤。为什么带着伤腿还出来？

scripts.text:
[Frede]
I can still move around with this leg and I wanted to help the village.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
这条腿还能走动，我想帮助村庄。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But you should stay home and recover.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但你应该待在家里休养。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
The fact is, my leg will never recover.
I can only keep my injury from getting worse.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
事实是，我的腿永远好不了了。
我只能防止伤势恶化。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
But I'm grateful that I can still move around.
Ha......
When did we start to be afraid of 'death'.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
但我感激自己还能走动。
哈......
我们是从什么时候开始害怕“死亡”的？

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Saphas have never had any 'sicknesses' and we don't die unless there is a terrible accident.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
萨法从未有过“疾病”，除非遭遇可怕的事故，否则我们不会死亡。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
This is also the reason why we Saphas can maintain a perfect community.
We didn't have to be greedy.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
这也是我们萨法能维持完美社区的原因。
我们不需要贪婪。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
But suddenly we are hit with this epidemic and many Saphas have lost their loved ones ever since.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
但突然爆发了这场瘟疫，许多萨法失去了亲人。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
We weren't prepared for such a disaster.
It was chaos. Nobody knew what to do but watch them die.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
我们对这样的灾难毫无准备。
一片混乱。除了眼睁睁看着他们死去，谁也不知道该怎么办。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
It was worse for us because we never experienced death from getting old.
I also thought my ^f57d7dStill Friends^000000 would wake up one day.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
对我们来说更糟，因为我们从未经历过老死。
我也曾以为我的^f57d7d挚友^000000有一天会醒来。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
But after a while, we realized it was a sickness that led to death and started to search for a cure but the situation was out of control.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
但过了一段时间，我们意识到这是一种致死疾病，并开始寻找治疗方法，但局势已经失控。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
We are very advanced in science technology but we lack knowledge in the medical field.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
我们在科技方面非常先进，但在医学领域缺乏知识。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
A medicine was completed only after we lost many lives but it isn't enough to completely cure the sickness.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
在失去许多生命之后，药物才研制出来，但它不足以完全治愈这种疾病。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
As long as I don't forget to take my Bradium, I can keep from getting any worse.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
只要我不忘记服用魔力之石，就能防止病情恶化。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
I recently did some ^f57d7drepair work in the cave next to the village^000000, but I forgot to take Bradium while I was working.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
我最近去^f57d7d村庄旁边的洞穴^000000做了一些修复工作，但工作时忘了服用魔力之石。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
I usually carry extra Bradium with me when I go outside of town for work but you can easily lose sense of time in a cave.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
我通常外出工作时都会随身携带备用的魔力之石，但在洞穴里很容易忘记时间。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Oh no!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
Come... to think of it....
My friends!!!!!!!!!!

[Frede]
I haven't seen my friends who I worked with in the cave.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
我还没见到和我一起在洞穴工作的朋友们。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
They have to return to the village once every few days to replenish their Bradium.
Maybe......they forgot?
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
他们每隔几天就要回村庄补充魔力之石。
也许......他们忘了？

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Oh... what should I do......
I would run there myself if only my legs would move normally.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
啊...我该怎么办......
要是我的腿能正常活动，我早就亲自跑过去了。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Would you mind visiting the cave to see if my friends are alright?
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
你介意去洞穴看看我的朋友们是否平安吗？

scripts.text: Will do.
scripts.translation: 我会去的。

scripts.text: No can't do.
scripts.translation: 我做不到。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Thank you so much.
My memory is a bit fuzzy since its been a while since I came back to the village,
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
非常感谢。
因为离开村庄已经有一段时间了，我的记忆有些模糊，

scripts.text:
[Frede]
but you will find a ^f57d7dcave nearby the village with repairmen work going on^000000.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

I only hope they are all healthy and well.

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

{0} I'm forever in your debt!

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

We may be from different races but we can be great friends.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Brian]
You never know what kind of accident might happen if we don't do a thorough job.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩]
如果不彻底检查，谁知道会发生什么意外。

scripts.text:
[Brian]
Not only is creating things important, but regular maintenance is also very important.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩]
制造东西很重要，但定期维护也非常重要。

scripts.text:
[Brian]

scripts.text:

How is he doing?

[布莱恩]
哦，你是来找弗雷德的？
他最近怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Brian]

scripts.translation:
[布莱恩]
我几天前还见过他，但我总是担心我的老朋友。

scripts.text:
[Brian]
I hope he is getting used to his new work.
I shouldn't be worried because he is very hardworking but...
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩]
希望他能适应新的工作。
我不该担心的，因为他非常勤劳，但是...

scripts.text:
[Brian]
He got sick by overworking himself already. But you don't have to tell him I said this.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩]
他之前因为过度劳累已经生过病了。不过，你别告诉他是我说的。

scripts.text:
[Brian]
I just hope his condition doesn't get worse.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩]
我只希望他的病情不要恶化。

scripts.text:

啊...这让我想起来，我来这里已经多少天了...
你知道今天是什么日子吗？

scripts.text:

I'm out of Bradium already.
Frede has been nagging me about this all the time but now I see why.
haha.
scripts.translation:

我的魔力之石已经用完了。
弗雷德一直唠叨我这件事，现在我知道原因了。
哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Brian]
Please tell Frede that I will return to the village after I recover.
scripts.translation:

请告诉弗雷德，等我康复后就会回村庄。

scripts.text:

I still see things to fix after fixing all day!
It's logical to fix things that needs to be fixed!!
scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:
[布伊]
我不知道。抱歉。
他让你来做什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He asked me to deliver Bradium to his friends working in the cave outside the village.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他让我把魔力之石交给在村庄外洞穴工作的朋友们。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
Oh no. I don't have any portable Bradium because of insufficient supplies.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
糟糕。由于补给不足，我这里没有可携带的魔力之石。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
I will only be able to get the Bradium that is being refined now in a few days. We let Pioms returning from outside work stay and rest in the village.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
目前正在精炼的魔力之石还要几天才能完成。我们让从外面回来的皮奥姆在村里休息。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
But I see they haven't returned yet.
They must be out of Bradium by now.
This isn't good.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
但我看他们还没回来。
他们现在的魔力之石肯定已经用完了。
这不好。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
Worst case, they wouldn't come back to the village at all.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
最坏的情况是，他们根本不会回到村里。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is there another way?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
还有其他办法吗？

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
It takes a lot of time to refine a large Bradium mineral but small pieces of Bradium will be quick.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
精炼大块魔力之石需要很长时间，但小块魔力之石很快就能完成。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
Bradium mineral can be collected anywhere in this area but the effectiveness of refined pieces is low.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
在这个区域任何地方都能采集魔力之石，但精炼后的小块效果较低。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
You can easily collect ^f57d7dpieces of Bradium from monsters nearby^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
你可以轻松地从附近的魔物身上掉落^f57d7d魔力之石碎片^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
About ^f57d7d30 pieces of Bradium^000000 will be enough to share with 6 people.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
大约^f57d7d30块魔力之石碎片^000000就足够6个人分享了。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
You've brought back the Bradium.
I've been waiting for the Galtens to return because I'm not accustomed to battle since I'm Venknick. Thank you very much.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
你带回了魔力之石。
我一直在等加尔滕们回来，因为我是文克尼克，不习惯战斗。非常感谢。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
Handwork is much faster to refine pieces of Bradium instead of using a machine. I will only need two hours to finish.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
手工精炼魔力之石碎片比使用机器快得多。我只需要两个小时就能完成。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
Please go rest while I get to work.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
请去休息，我去工作。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
Bradium mineral can be collected anywhere in this area but the effectiveness of refined pieces is low.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
在这个区域任何地方都能采集魔力之石，但精炼后的小块效果较低。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
You can easily collect ^f57d7dpieces of Bradium from monsters nearby^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
你可以轻松地从附近的魔物身上掉落^f57d7d魔力之石碎片^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
About ^f57d7d30 pieces of Bradium^000000 will be enough to share with 6 people.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
大约^f57d7d30块魔力之石碎片^000000就足够6个人分享了。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
I did it!
I was a bit nervous because it has been a long time since I did manual work but I think I did a good job.
Please take these to them.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
完成了！
因为很久没做手工了，我有点紧张，但我觉得做得不错。
请把这些交给他们。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
I'm still working on it so please rest a little more.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
我还在工作中，请再多休息一会儿。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
Saphas cannot live unless we consume Bradium continuously.
That is why we needed spaces for us to inject Bradium all over the village.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
萨法族如果不持续摄取魔力之石就无法生存。
所以我们需要在村庄各处设置注入魔力之石的空间。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
But those working outside of the village cannot return often to refill their Bradium so we provide Bradium that is portable.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
但在村庄外工作的人无法经常回来补充魔力之石，所以我们提供便携式的魔力之石。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
But there was a problem with the Bradium mining in the Manuk area recently and we have a shortage of supplies. We don't have enough to give out.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
但最近马努克地区的魔力之石开采出了问题，导致供应短缺。我们手头没有足够的库存可以发放。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
That is why many Pioms working in the outskirts of the village return for more supplies,
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
这就是为什么许多在村庄外围工作的皮奥姆族要频繁回来领取补给，

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
and the time spent on transportation is what is slowing down work.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
而花在运输上的时间拖慢了工作进度。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
To tell you the truth, transportation time doesn't make much difference but it adds up in the end.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
说实话，单次运输时间的差异并不大，但累积起来就很可观了。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
We call this the ^f57d7dCreamy Effect^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
我们将这种现象称为^f57d7d克瑞米效应^000000。

scripts.text:
[Maha]
But I do think the Sapha race is overly kind, almost unnaturally.
Guess it'll be fine.
scripts.translation:
[玛哈]
但我总觉得萨法族过于善良了，简直有些不自然。
不过应该没事吧。

scripts.text:
[Ben]
There is nothing strange!
I'd love to be like you and respected by many people.
scripts.translation:
[本]
没有什么奇怪的！
我倒是很想成为像你那样，受到许多人尊敬的人。

scripts.text:
[Ben]
I can also visit the Sapha if I work well here, can't I?
scripts.translation:
[本]
只要我在这里工作表现好，也能去拜访萨法族，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Ben]
Hmm. Hey, Maha,
what do you think?
Why do you think he is here?
scripts.translation:
[本]
嗯。嘿，玛哈，
你怎么看？
你觉得他为什么在这里？

scripts.text:
[Maha]
Don't know. Not interested.
scripts.translation:
[玛哈]
不知道。不感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Ben]
Don't you find that guy strange?
I've never seen his race before I joined the expedition.
scripts.translation:
[本]
你不觉得那个人很奇怪吗？
在我加入探险队之前，我从未见过他的种族。

scripts.text:
[Maha]
Ah. Really?
Then it's only you.
There must be a reason why he is here.
scripts.translation:
[玛哈]
啊。是吗？
那就只有你一个人了。
他出现在这里肯定是有原因的。

scripts.text:
[Maha]
They may make an announcement soon.
All we need to do is wait for the announcement.
It will give us the answers.
scripts.translation:
[玛哈]
他们很快就会发布公告。
我们要做的只是等待公告。
到时候一切就清楚了。

scripts.text: What is it?
scripts.translation: 什么事？

scripts.text: Stay silent and listen.
scripts.translation: 保持沉默，继续听

scripts.text:
[Ben]
Hmm...
That can be true but aren't you thinking too much?
scripts.translation:
[本]
嗯...
虽然可能是这样，但你是不是想太多了？

scripts.text:
[Maha]
I don't like to get into trouble.
I only follow orders.
Besides, there is nothing out of the ordinary.
scripts.translation:
[玛哈]
我不喜欢惹麻烦。
我只是服从命令。
况且，目前一切都很正常。

scripts.text:
[Maha]
From what I can tell
That tree-like giant race called Sapha are kind.
There won't be any trouble. Relax.
scripts.translation:
[玛哈]
据我所知，
那个树状的巨人种族萨法是友善的。
不会有什么麻烦。放心吧。

scripts.text:
[Ben]
Huh? Did you hear us?
Nothing really or maybe something...
So...
scripts.translation:
[本]
咦？你听到我们说话了？
没什么大事，也许有一点...
所以...

scripts.text:
[Ben]
Research members dispatched to Manuk just came back.
But...
scripts.translation:
[本]
派往马努克的研究成员刚刚回来了。
但是...

scripts.text: But?
scripts.translation: 但是？

scripts.text:
[Ben]
Well... they came back with a Manuk messenger!
...Sapha of Manuk.
scripts.translation:
[本]
嗯...他们带回了马努克的信使！
...马努克的萨法。

scripts.text: Where is he?!
scripts.translation: 他在哪里？！

scripts.text: Is this top secret information?!
scripts.translation: 这是最高机密吗？！

scripts.text:
[Ben]
He's in the command center right now.
We should go there.
scripts.translation:
[本]
他就在指挥中心。
我们该去那里。

scripts.text:
[Ben]
Excuse me.
There was no order to restrict or keep it a secret.
And it looks like they are making an official visit.
scripts.translation:
[本]
抱歉。
并没有下达限制或保密的命令。
而且看起来他们是在进行正式访问。

scripts.text:
[Ben]
We might be able to know something if we go to the command center now
Try seeing ^4d4dffAello^000000.
scripts.translation:
[本]
如果我们现在去指挥中心，也许能了解到一些情况。
试着去见见^4d4dff艾洛^000000。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
Ah, you. Good timing.
I have something urgent to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
啊，是你。来得正好。
我有件急事要告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
Do you happen to know that a messenger from Manuk is here?
Not a big secret but..
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
你知道马努克的信使来了吗？
这不是什么大秘密，但是...

scripts.text:
[Aello]
The Sapha from Manuk wants to talk to you.
Agiff says anyone of from the expedition can meet him but..
I think someone with more experience should go.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
马努克的萨法想和你谈谈。
阿吉夫说远征队的任何人都可以见他，但是...
我觉得应该派更有经验的人去。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
I know your abilities
and trust you.
The delegation is in the room at the right on the second floor.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
我知道你的能力，
也信任你。
代表团在二楼右边的房间里。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
There will be a guard standing in front
just tell him you got authorization.
He is interested in humans, so try to be courteous while talking to him.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
门口会有卫兵站岗，
告诉他你已获得授权即可。
他对人类很感兴趣，所以交谈时请保持礼貌。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
It's the room at the right on the second floor.
There is a guard in front of the room.
He'll let you pass if you tell him you have authorization.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
是二楼右边的房间。
房间前面有卫兵。
告诉他你已获得授权，他就会放行。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
Try not to give unnecessary information
and only do small talk.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
尽量不要提供不必要的信息，
只进行寒暄即可。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
I knew I could count on you.
You're activities will help us tremendously in expanding our territory.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
我就知道可以指望你。
你的行动将极大地帮助我们扩展领土。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
I am only interested in the most skillful
and trustworthy person among the Ash-Vacuum expedition.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
我只对阿什-真空远征队中
最熟练且最值得信赖的人感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
But.. you are a new face around here.
Hmm... sorry but you won't do.
You'll have to get yourself familiar with this camp first.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
但是...你是这里的新面孔。
嗯...抱歉，你不行。
你得先熟悉一下这个营地。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Sorry, but this room is currently restricted from visitors.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
抱歉，这个房间目前禁止访客进入。

scripts.text: I have authorization.
scripts.translation: 我有授权

scripts.text: Is that so.
scripts.translation: 是吗

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
You do?
What is your name.
Thank you.
So you are {0}.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
你有吗？
请报上您的名字。
谢谢。
原来您是{0}。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
You may go in now.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
您现在可以进去了。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
You mustn't enter without Aello's permission.
No exceptions.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
未经艾洛许可，不得入内。
没有任何例外。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
You're back.
Are you acquainted with the Sapha messenger now?
We have high expectations from you.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
您回来了。
您现在认识萨法的信使了吗？
我们对您寄予厚望。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Sorry.
This room is restricted from visitors.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
抱歉。
此房间禁止访客进入。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Let's continue..
Although the details are already settled.
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
我们继续...
虽然细节已经定下来了。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Ah, yes.
Where was I?
Ah, yes.
El Dicastes!
El Dicastes is the capital city of Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
啊，是的。
我刚才说到哪了？
啊，是的。
艾尔迪卡斯特！
艾尔迪卡斯特是萨法的首都。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
A city like a sparkling jewel in white snow.
Manuk was originally a village created to mine Bradium.
El Dicastes has now grown to be the Sapha home ground.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
一座如白雪中闪耀宝石般的城市。
马努克最初是一个为了开采魔力之石而建立的村庄。
如今，艾尔迪卡斯特已经发展成为萨法的大本营。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Ravail holds all authority in El Dicastes
and makes decisions on reports from Manuk.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
拉维尔在艾尔迪卡斯特拥有最高权力，
并根据马努克的报告做出决策。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Kind race born from a world other than ours
we are grateful for your kindness
in helping and cooperating with us.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
来自我们世界之外的友善种族，
感谢你们对我们的帮助与合作。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Ravail, representative of Sapha
would like to invite humans to El Dicastes,
Sapha's capital city.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
萨法的代表拉维尔
希望邀请人类前往艾尔迪卡斯特，
也就是萨法的首都。

scripts.text: Invite? Visit? City?!
scripts.translation: 邀请？参观？城市？！

scripts.text: What is that suppose to mean, Hound?
scripts.translation: 这是什么意思，猎犬？

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Just as he said.
Our expedition team has helped the Saphas for some time.
Collect Bradium for their survival or
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
正如他所说。
我们的远征队已经帮助萨法一段时间了。
为他们的生存收集魔力之石，或者

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Eliminate vicious beasts that threaten them.
.. ......
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
消灭威胁他们的凶恶野兽。
.. ......

scripts.text:
[Hound]
So they have given us an official invitation to visit their capital city in return.
That is why I've been selecting expedition members to send to El Dicastes, the capital city of Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
作为回报，他们正式邀请我们访问他们的首都。
这就是我为什么一直在挑选远征队成员，派往萨法的首都艾尔迪卡斯特。

scripts.text: ..You mean..
scripts.translation: ..你的意思是..

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Yes.
That is what he meant.
Agiff also approved before he left.
{0}, you are invited.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
是的。
他的意思就是这个。
阿吉夫离开前也批准了。
{0}，您被邀请了。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
You are kind and respect others
polite and trustworthy and most of all, fun in character.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
您善良且尊重他人，
彬彬有礼，值得信赖，
最重要的是，您风趣幽默。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
You are perfect. Ravail will approve too.
That is why I'm here.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
您完美无缺。拉维尔也会赞同的。
这就是我在此的原因。

scripts.text: Never would have imagined.
scripts.translation: 我从未想过。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Shouldn't you already be used to the unexpected by now?
Come on... you're not a rookie.. haha.
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
难道您不应该已经习惯这种意外了吗？
拜托...您可不是新人...哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
If you are going to leave, better be now.
Come back to me once you are ready to leave.
I will let you know your mission.
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
如果您要离开，最好现在就动身。
当您准备好出发时，请回来找我。
我会告知您任务详情。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
First go to Manuk and meet General Guard Avalanche.
Avalanche will be heavily armed because he is Galten.
You can't miss him.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
首先前往马努克，会见卫兵队长雪崩。
雪崩会全副武装，因为他是加尔滕。
您不会认不出他的。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Once you tell Avalanche that you are a guest of the city, he will let you pass the path to El Dicastes.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
一旦您告诉雪崩您是城市的客人，他就会允许您通过前往艾尔迪卡斯特的道路。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
You cannot go pass without his approval so make sure you get his permission.
He will let you pass with my recommendations.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
没有他的批准您无法通过，所以务必获得他的许可。
凭借我的推荐，他会让您通过的。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
I'm a little excited.
on what our meeting will bring in the future.
Only hope it won't be like a blizzard in the middle of the night.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
我有点兴奋，
期待这次会面在未来会带来什么。
只希望不会像深夜的暴风雪一样。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
My name is Hound.
Are you here by Aello's request?
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
我的名字是猎犬。
您是应艾洛的请求来的吗？

scripts.text: Yes. He told me to meet the Sapha.
scripts.translation: 是的。他让我来见萨法。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Okay. You should be able to talk to him, right?
Shall we start with introducing ourselves?
This is...
{0}...
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
好的。您应该能和他交谈，对吧？
我们要不先互相介绍一下？
这位是...
{0}...

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
My name is Vyhannus.
{0}..?
Glad to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
我的名字是维汉努斯。
{0}..？
很高兴见到您。

scripts.text: Same here.
scripts.translation: 彼此彼此。

scripts.text: A tree monster!
scripts.translation: 树魔物！

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Amazing.
Like with Hound, that ring you humans made...
is like a ring of wisdom.
[Vyhannus]
Shall we skip to the point?
The reason why I am here...
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
令人惊叹。
就像猎犬一样，你们人类制作的那个戒指...
就像智慧之戒。
[维汉努斯]
我们要不直接进入正题？
我在此的原因...

scripts.text:
[Hound]
What are you saying?
That was rude!
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
你在说什么？
太无礼了！

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Oh. Monster?
That is something new.
Hound. I'm fine. You humans are amusing.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
哦。魔物？
这可是新鲜事。
猎犬。我没事。你们人类真有趣。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Shall we skip to the point?
The reason why I am here...
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
我们要不直接进入正题？
我在此的原因...

scripts.text:
[Someone's voice]
Excuse me, hold on a second.
scripts.translation:
[某人的声音]
打扰一下，请稍等。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Commander!
You've come at such short notice.
Is there a situation?
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
指挥官！
您来得好突然。
发生什么事了吗？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Huh? Nothing.
Was there anything.
You said you wanted to send a trustworthy person, right?
I wanted to see the person Aello chosen to send.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嗯？没什么。
你刚才说想派个可靠的人去，对吧？
我想看看艾洛选中的那个人是谁。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hm... Ah.
Is it you?
I see, just as Aello explained.
Well, I think we are in good hands if it is you.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嗯...啊。
原来是你啊。
看来正如艾洛所说的那样。
如果是你的话，我想我们交给你了。

scripts.text: What are you implying?
scripts.translation: 你这话是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
So... It's like this.
Both Saphas and humans had many differences in the past.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
是这样的。
过去，萨法族和人类之间有很多差异。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
We've worried about becoming enemies with your race after you've suddenly appeared
and were afraid of your abilities.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
你们突然出现后，我们担心会与你们种族成为敌人，
并且对你们的能力感到恐惧。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
But you have respected us Saphas
and helped Manuk with many deeds.
We've come to recognize humans as good people.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
但你们尊重我们萨法族，
并为马努克做出了许多贡献。
我们开始认可人类是善良的人。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Yes, we made efforts.
We also tried to keep a neutral attitude.
Because it is always better to strengthen amnity as a third party then taking sides in a conflict.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
是的，我们也付出了努力。
我们也试图保持中立的态度。
因为在冲突中，作为第三方加强友好关系总比选边站要好。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Well..
Not totally wrong, I guess...
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
嗯...
也不能说完全不对...

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
(Vyhannus smiles)
We have told Ravail about you humans.
Ravail is the highest elder of glorious ^4d4dffEl Dicastes^000000.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
(维汉努斯微笑)
我们已经向拉维尔介绍了你们人类。
拉维尔是光辉^4d4dff艾尔·迪卡斯特^000000的最高长老。

scripts.text: El Dicastes?
scripts.translation: 艾尔·迪卡斯特？

scripts.text: Ravail?
scripts.translation: 拉维尔？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Ah, sorry for interrupting.
I have to go now.
Hound, I approve.
I think he will do just fine.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
啊，抱歉打断了。
我得走了。
猎犬，我批准了。
我觉得他会做得很好。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Then it's settled with him.
And... ah yes, you.
Please go meet the inspector in the next room after this.
Got it?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
那就决定是他了。
还有...啊对了，你。
结束后请去隔壁房间见检查员。
明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I'm leaving now.
Vyhannus? I'll come by to see you again.
And you should ^4d4dffmeet Inspector Doha after talking with Vyhannus^000000.
Then bye everyone.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我要走了。
维汉努斯？我之后会再来拜访你。
还有，你应该^4d4dff在和维汉努斯交谈后去见检查员道哈^000000。
那么，大家再见。

scripts.text:
Commander Hibba Agip quickly left the room after saying what he wanted to say.
First, let's listen to Vyhannus's story.
scripts.translation:
指挥官希巴·阿吉普说完话后迅速离开了房间。
首先，让我们听听维汉努斯的故事。

scripts.text: -Looks like the Sapha messenger from Manuk.-
scripts.translation: -看起来像是来自马努克的萨法族信使。-

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Sorry but will you leave now?
You don't seem to have authorization from the captain or Aello?
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
抱歉，请你现在离开吗？
你似乎没有获得船长或艾洛的授权？

scripts.text:
[Sapha]
- This person look like the Sapha messenger from Manuk. -
You just stand there without
knowing what he says, so the
expedition guard next to you starts to talk. -
scripts.translation:
[萨法]
- 这个人看起来像是来自马努克的萨法族信使。-
你只是站在那里，不知道他在说什么，
于是你旁边的探险队卫兵开始说话了。-

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Your commander is like the wind.
We have someone like that in Manuk, too.
He's name is Galten. He is so quick, you won't notice the weight of his armor.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
你的指挥官就像风一样。
马努克也有这样的人。
他叫加尔滕。他动作极快，你甚至感觉不到他盔甲的重量。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Avalanche will be at the Manuk Operations building.
Once he approves, you can use the tunnel that leads to the capital city.
The tunnel might be a little scary.
But I'm sure you will reach the end of it since you are strong.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
雪崩会在马努克运营大楼。
一旦他批准，你就可以使用通往首都的隧道。
隧道可能会让人有点害怕。
但既然你很强大，我相信你能走到尽头。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Oh, the tunnel?
It was originally a mineral mine.
But we found ourselves on the opposite side while mining away.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
哦，隧道？
它原本是一座矿石矿。
但我们在挖掘时，发现自己到了另一侧。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
We found better mines afterwards and that is how Manuk came about.
The tunnel is reorganized with paths between the capital city and Manuk.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
后来我们发现了更好的矿脉，马努克就是这样形成的。
隧道被重新整理，成为了连接首都和马努克的通道。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
That is it.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
就是这样。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
You received the Light of El Dicastes.
With this, you can return to Diel from anywhere, anytime.
Looks like an item made for your convenience.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
你获得了埃迪斯特斯之光。
有了它，你可以随时从任何地方返回迪尔。
看起来是个为你方便而制作的物品。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Ravail seems to like you very much.
The Light of El Dicastes is convenient to use instead of moving through long tunnels.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
拉维尔似乎非常喜欢你。
比起穿过漫长的隧道，使用埃迪斯特斯之光更方便。

[Vyhannus]
Oh, the tunnel?
It was originally a mineral mine.
But we found ourselves on the opposite side while mining away.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
哦，隧道？
它原本是一座矿石矿。
但我们在挖掘时，发现自己到了另一侧。

scripts.text:

That is it.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
就是这样。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
The tunnel that connects Manuk and the capital city.
It was originally a mineral mine.
But we found ourselves on the opposite side while mining away.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
连接马努克和首都的隧道。
它原本是一座矿石矿。
但我们在挖掘时，发现自己到了另一侧。

We found better mines afterwards and that is how Manuk came about.
