后来我们发现了更好的矿脉，马努克就是这样形成的。
隧道被重新整理，成为了连接首都和马努克的通道。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Where is your interpreter ring?
I'm not going to be your personal translator.
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
你的翻译戒指呢？
我可不想当你的私人翻译。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Where is the interpreter ring?
We should create it if we don't have one.
I would like to speak in person.
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
翻译戒指在哪里？
如果没有，我们应该制作一个。
我想直接对话。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Sorry but will you leave now?
You don't seem to have authorization from the captain or Aello?
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
抱歉，请你现在离开吗？
你似乎没有获得船长或艾洛的授权？

scripts.text:
[Hound]
First thing you need to do when you reach Manuk is to meet General Guard Avalanche.
Tell Avalanche that you are the one invited by Vyhannus.
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
你到达马努克后首先要做的事，是去见卫队长雪崩。
告诉雪崩，你是受维汉努斯邀请而来的。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Then you'll go through a simply process of confirmation and will be permitted to go through the tunnel to the capital city.
Passing through the tunnel is easy as long as you are polite.
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
然后你会经过一个简单的确认流程，并被允许通过隧道前往首都。
只要你有礼貌，通过隧道很容易。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
And don't forget what the captain said.
Inspector Doha is in the next room.
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
别忘了船长说的话。
检查员道哈在隔壁房间。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
I've just returned from Manuk from a long term dispatch
and haven't gotten any rest yet.
El Dicastes.. I will find the time to visit once your advance party settles in.
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
我刚从马努克长期外派回来，
还没得到休息。
埃迪斯特斯...等你的先遣队安顿好后，我会找时间拜访。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
I have to take care of Vyhannus here.
We might see the day when Saphas like Vyhannus will be living with us on our continent.
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
我得在这里照顾维汉努斯。
也许有一天，像维汉努斯这样的萨法族会和我们生活在这片大陆上。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
I've just returned from Manuk from a long term dispatch
and haven't gotten any rest yet.
El Dicastes.. I will find the time to visit once your advance party settles in.
scripts.translation:

还没得到休息。
埃迪斯特斯...等你的先遣队安顿好后，我会找时间拜访。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
I have to take care of Vyhannus here.
We might see the day when Saphas like Vyhannus will be living with us on our continent.
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
我得在这里照顾维汉努斯。
也许有一天，像维汉努斯这样的萨法族会和我们生活在这片大陆上。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hmm..?
I should go now.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嗯..？
我该走了。

scripts.text:
[Guard Captain Avalanche]
�����? �� ����...
���� �� ?
���..?

[Guard Captain Avalanche]
[Avalanche]
You are human.
What do you want here?
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 雪崩]
[雪崩]
你是人类。
你来这里有什么事？

scripts.text:
[Guard Captain Avalanche]
[Avalanche]
Go out of this building and straight below the mountain east from the village.
You will know where it is if you see soldiers guarding the tunnel.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 雪崩]
[雪崩]
走出这栋建筑，沿着村庄东侧的山脚一直走。
如果你看到士兵在守卫隧道，就知道地方了。

scripts.text:
[Guard Captain Avalanche]
[Avalanche]
Oh... You have the Light of El Dicastes.
it would be helpful for your travel.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 雪崩]
[雪崩]
哦...你有埃迪斯特斯之光。
这对你的旅途会有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Guard Captain Avalanche]
[Avalanche]
The path to the capital city was previously a mine.
so we have reports of wild monsters appearing although the tunnel is well maintained.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 雪崩]
[雪崩]
通往首都的道路以前是矿道。
虽然隧道维护得很好，但我们仍收到过野生魔物出现的报告。

scripts.text: I've come with Vyhannus's invitation.
scripts.translation: 我是受维汉努斯邀请来的。

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
Ah. Jarute Vyhannus.
I thought it would be better for him to take a guard with him but.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 雪崩]
[雪崩]
啊。贾鲁特·维汉努斯。
我原本觉得让他带个卫兵一起走比较好，但是...

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
I guess Vyhannus had trust in you humans.
I'm fine as long as Vyhannus approved you.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 雪崩]
[雪崩]
看来维汉努斯很信任你们人类。
只要维汉努斯认可了你，我就没问题。

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
I authorize you to pass through to El Dicastes, the capital city.
There is a tunnel that leads to the capital city right outside this building which goes down by the east mountain range of this village.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 雪崩]
[雪崩]
我授权你通过前往首都埃迪斯特斯。
就在这个建筑外面，有一条通往首都的隧道，它沿着本村东侧的山脉向下延伸。

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
It is a tunnel that reaches the capital city. There is no other detour because Kamidal mountain is so huge.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 雪崩]
[雪崩]
这是一条通往首都的隧道。因为卡米达尔山脉非常巨大，没有其他绕路。

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
The tunnel is well maintained but there was a time when part of the tunnel which connects
with the lowest cave of the mountain collapsed and reports of wild monsters was received.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 雪崩]
[雪崩]
隧道维护得很好，但曾经有一段连接山体最深处洞穴的隧道坍塌过，并收到了野生魔物出现的报告。

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
So I recommend that you move in a group.
It is dangerous and can be a long journey.
That is all I have to say for now.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 雪崩]
[雪崩]
所以我建议你们结伴而行。
那里很危险，而且路途遥远。
目前我就说这么多。

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
Please let me know any news about the capital city when you come back.
Hahaha..
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 雪崩]
[雪崩]
等你回来时，请告诉我首都的消息。
哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
I hope that the Light of El Dicastes will show you the way.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 雪崩]
[雪崩]
希望埃迪斯特斯之光能为你指引方向。

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
The path to the capital city was previously a mine.
so we have reports of wild monsters appearing although the tunnel is well maintained.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 雪崩]
[雪崩]
通往首都的道路以前是矿道。
虽然隧道维护得很好，但我们仍收到过野生魔物出现的报告。

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
Always take care of yourself at all times.
Haha.. but then you humans are very strong.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 雪崩]
[雪崩]
请时刻注意安全。
哈哈...不过你们人类很强壮。

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
The path to the capital city was previously a mine.
so we have reports of wild monsters appearing although the tunnel is well maintained.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 雪崩]
[雪崩]
通往首都的道路以前是矿道。
虽然隧道维护得很好，但我们仍收到过野生魔物出现的报告。

scripts.text:

Haha... but then you humans are very strong.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 雪崩]
[雪崩]
请时刻注意安全。
哈哈...不过你们人类很强壮。

scripts.text: - Cannot communicate with him. -
scripts.translation: - 无法与他交流。 -

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: Register as an adventurer.
scripts.translation: 注册为冒险者

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Do you want to register as an adventurer?
Strange.
You are not on our list of visitors.
Did you enter without permission?
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
您想注册为冒险者？
奇怪。
您不在我们的访客名单上。
您是未经许可进入的吗？

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
All other races without official permission are restricted.
I will send for a Galten right away.
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
所有其他种族若无官方许可均被限制进入。
我马上叫一个加尔滕过来。

scripts.text:
The Sapha clerk is ready to call on a Guard Galten any time.
It's best to avoid this situation.
scripts.translation:
萨法的职员随时都可以呼叫卫兵加尔滕。
最好避免这种情况发生。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Do you want to register as an adventurer?
I will compare with the invitation list from Manuk.
What is your name?
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
您想注册为冒险者？
我会核对来自马努克的邀请名单。
请问您贵姓？

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Yes.. {0}...
I found it.
Welcome to El Dicastes, capital city of Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
是的...{0}...
我找到了。
欢迎来到萨法的首都艾尔迪卡斯特。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
You will be treated the same as other Saphas here
and is allowed to do as you wish
and can have contracts with official requests from Dicastes.
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
在这里，您将受到与其他萨法同等的待遇，
可以随心所欲地行动，
也可以接受来自艾尔迪卡斯特的官方委托。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
This is a little souvenir for visiting El Dicastes.
You can use it to return to El Dicastes whenever you wish.
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
这是您访问艾尔迪卡斯特的纪念品。
您可以随时使用它返回艾尔迪卡斯特。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
There is a special place for humans located beneath the residential area of Pioms.
It is called in your language...
Pub. Hope you get to visit there.
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
在皮奥姆居住区的下方，有一处专门供人类使用的地方。
用你们的语言来说...
叫酒馆。希望您能去那里坐坐。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Strange.
Aren't you already registered?
I see your name in the records.
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
奇怪。
您不是已经注册过了吗？
我在记录里看到了您的名字。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
I recognize you.
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
我认识您。
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: I want to meet the minister.
scripts.translation: 我想见大臣

scripts.text: Nothing particular.
scripts.translation: 没什么特别的

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
You want to meet the minister?
Which minister?
Ravail cannot be met in person even with exploit certifications.
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
您想见大臣？
哪位大臣？
即使持有功勋证明，也无法面见拉维尔。

scripts.text: Ahat
scripts.translation: 阿哈特

scripts.text: Another minister
scripts.translation: 另一位大臣

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
You've really collected 3 exploit certification of Sapha already.
Alright. I will send a request.
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
您竟然已经收集了3个萨法的功勋证明。
好吧。我会提交申请。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Please take the elevator up to the Administrative Office.
There is another elevator in the corridor next to the Administrative Office.
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
请乘坐电梯前往行政办公室。
行政办公室旁边的走廊里还有另一部电梯。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
It is a separate elevator that leads to the high minister's office
You will be guided in front of the office.
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
那是通往高级大臣办公室的专用电梯。
您会被引导到办公室门口。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
You need 3 exploit certification of Sapha to meet Ahat.
You know what exploit certification of Sapha is, right?
Well, please try to help around El Dicastes to collect them.
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
您需要3个萨法的功勋证明才能面见阿哈特。
您知道什么是萨法的功勋证明吧？
嗯，请尝试在艾尔迪卡斯特帮忙收集它们。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Another minister? Who?
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
另一位大臣？是谁？

scripts.text: Sorry, but I know no one else.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不认识其他人

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
You are difficult.
Unlike other Saphas, ministers are very busy.
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
您真难缠。
与其他萨法不同，大臣们非常忙碌。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
What are you curious about today?
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
今天您想了解些什么？

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Ahat is on the same floor as high minister Ravail.
Take the elevator up to the Administrative Office and then you will be guided in front of the separate elevator.
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
阿哈特与高级大臣拉维尔在同一层楼。
请乘坐电梯前往行政办公室，之后会有人引导您到专用电梯前。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
What are you curious about today?
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
今天您想了解些什么？

scripts.text: About official requests
scripts.translation: 关于官方委托

scripts.text: About the adventurer's pub
scripts.translation: 关于冒险者酒馆

scripts.text: Ahat?
scripts.translation: 阿哈特？

scripts.text: Exploit certification of Sapha?
scripts.translation: 萨法的功勋证明？

scripts.text: End conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
If Diel or ministers need help on operations in the capital
they post a notice on the public board.
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
如果迪尔或大臣们需要协助处理首都的事务，
他们会在公告板上发布告示。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Anyone who can take the job can take up the request.
Adventurers who are officially registered can also take jobs.
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
任何有能力的人都可以接受这些委托。
正式注册的冒险者也可以接取任务。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
After you handle a request
you are given an exploit certification for helping El Dicastes.
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
完成委托后，
您会获得一份功勋证明，以表彰您对艾尔迪卡斯特的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
It is better spend spare time on these official requests.
Because you are contributing to the community.
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
建议您利用空闲时间处理这些官方委托。
因为您是在为社区做贡献。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Due to the increase of visitors from other worlds,
some requests are targeted for you.
You can take your pick.
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
由于来自其他世界的访客增多，
部分委托是专门为您准备的。
您可以自由选择。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
The adventurer's pub is open for the convenience of visitors like you.
It is located in the Piom residential area below the mine and factory zone.
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
为了方便像您这样的访客，我们开设了冒险者酒馆。
它位于矿山和工厂区下方的皮奥姆居住区。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
We thought the living environment here would be unfamiliar and inconvenient for you.
So we tried to make a place that is similar to what you have back home with a little help from adventurers.
I hope you like it.
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
我们觉得这里的生活环境对您来说可能既陌生又不便。
所以在冒险者的帮助下，我们尝试打造了一个类似您家乡的地方。
希望您喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Ahat is the next minister in line after Ravail.
Why?
Because we respect her.
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
阿哈特是继拉维尔之后的下一位大臣。
为什么？
因为我们要尊重她。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
What should I say, we would like to protect her.
But I'm not sure how respect is used in your language.
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
该怎么说呢，我们想要保护她。
不过我不确定在您的语言中“尊重”是如何表达的。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Ahat is popular.
Not many have seen him and he works in her room all the time.
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
阿哈特很受欢迎。
很少有人见过他，他总是在房间里工作。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
If you want to meet Ahat..well.
He is really good at his work but is very shy of strangers..
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
如果您想见阿哈特...嗯。
他工作非常出色，但非常怕生...

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
He doesn't like to be in places where a lot of people are gathered.
That is why we barely see her.
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
他不喜欢人多拥挤的地方。
所以我们很少见到她。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Exploit certification?
Exploit certifications are made for outsiders like you.
They are given out as rewards when adventurers help with requests from Saphas throughout the city.
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
功勋证明？
功勋证明是为您这样的外来者准备的。
当冒险者协助处理萨法在城市各处发布的委托时，会作为奖励发放。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
The exploit certification is used to meet ministers.
I guess in order to meet busy ministers, you must at least contribute to our society.
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
功勋证明用于面见大臣。
我想，为了见到大忙人大臣，您至少需要为我们的社会做出贡献。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Please feel free to ask questions when you need help.
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
如果您需要帮助，请随时提问。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Please feel free to ask questions when you need help.
scripts.translation:
[职员 罗温]
如果您需要帮助，请随时提问。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of items. Let's try again after you reduce the number of items.
scripts.translation: 你的物品种类太多了。请在减少物品数量后再试一次。

scripts.text: Cannot proceed because the weight of your items is too heavy. Let's try again after you get rid of some weight.
scripts.translation: 由于您的物品重量过重，无法继续。请在减轻负重后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
Do you want to upgrade the ^990099Light of El Dicastes^000000 again?
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
您想再次强化^990099埃迪斯特斯之光^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
That will cost ^9900996 Sapha Certifications^000000 in order to retry.
And note this, your current Light of El Dicastes will be destroyed along with all of its enchantments.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
重试需要消耗^9900996个沙帕功勋证^000000。
请注意，您当前的埃迪斯特斯之光及其所有附魔都将被销毁。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
Are you sure you want to do this?
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
您确定要这样做吗？

scripts.text: No, let me think about it.
scripts.translation: 不，让我再想想。

scripts.text: Take my Light of El Dicastes.
scripts.translation: 把我的埃迪斯特斯之光交给你。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
You need to bring the Light of El Dicastes and 6 Sapha Certifications!
Don't try to cheat me!
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
您需要携带埃迪斯特斯之光和6个沙帕功勋证！
别想骗我！

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
Ok, let's get this started.
I'm going to remove all enchantments from your Light of El Dicastes.
Haaap--!
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
好的，我们开始吧。
我将移除您埃迪斯特斯之光上的所有附魔。
哈啊--！

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
The Exploit Certifications of Sapha that you collect by helping throughout the city has other uses besides meeting the minister.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
您通过协助城市事务获得的沙帕功勋证，除了用于面见大臣外，还有其他用途。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
If you come across an exploit certification, please come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
如果您获得了功勋证，请回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
I can cast an additional spell to your ^990099Light of El Dicastes^000000 accessory.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
我可以为您的^990099埃迪斯特斯之光^000000饰品附加额外的法术。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
You've come to awaken the ^990099Light of El Dicastes^000000 infinite strength.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
您是想唤醒^990099埃迪斯特斯之光^000000的无限力量。

scripts.text: Please explain.
scripts.translation: 请解释一下。

scripts.text: I want to upgrade.
scripts.translation: 我想强化它。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
I heard some craftsmen outside of the city can also cast spells on equipment.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
我听说城外的一些工匠也可以给装备附加法术。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
I'm the same but at least I don't destroy equipment.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
我和他们一样，但至少我不会弄坏装备。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
If you bring exploit certifications of Sapha, I will cast spells from 1 to 3 steps to your ^990099Light of El Dicastes^000000.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
如果您带来沙帕功勋证，我会为您的^990099埃迪斯特斯之光^000000附加1到3级的法术。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
But of course, since this is adding spells on top of its original magic, I cannot guarantee that you will get what you want on one try.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
但当然，既然这是在原有魔法基础上叠加法术，我无法保证您一次就能得到想要的结果。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
Either you are not wearing or don't have the equipment to upgrade on you.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
您身上没有穿戴或持有需要强化的装备。

scripts.text:
{0}
It is difficult to find fish here. Can't find any so Jahbong would forget that he's busy or angry at the sight of a Fish Tail.
scripts.translation:
{0}
这里很难找到鱼。找不到鱼的话，贾邦就会忘记自己很忙，或者看到鱼尾时就会生气。

scripts.text:
{0}
Grrr... I was punished with a ladle for peeing on my blanket yesterday.
scripts.translation:
{0}
咕噜...昨天我尿在毯子上，被勺子打了一顿。

scripts.text:
{0}
I dream sometimes of a giant patting me on the head. But I feel more annoyed than afraid.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我有时会梦见一个巨人抚摸我的头。但我感到的不是害怕，而是烦躁。

scripts.text:
{0}
Newbie Jarute, Ahat doesn't seem to look like a Sapha.
scripts.translation:
{0}
新手贾鲁特，阿哈特看起来不像沙帕人。

scripts.text:
{0}
Our people say Ahat looks like a beautiful cat.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我们的人说阿哈特看起来像一只美丽的猫。

scripts.text:
{0}
I heard there was a superior equipment upgrade craftsman in the capital city of Manuk.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我听说马努克的首都有一位高明的装备强化工匠。

scripts.text:
{0}
Grrr... I don't think my voice sounds normal these days. I think it's the weather.
scripts.translation:
{0}
咕噜...我觉得最近我的声音听起来不太正常。我想是天气的原因。

scripts.text:
{0}
There are times when I shout out loud but it is only because I am in a good mood. No need to be startled.
scripts.translation:
{0}
有时候我会大声喊叫，但那只是因为我心情好。不用大惊小怪。

scripts.text:
{0}
I feel an urge to jump on a pile with my four paws when I see one.
scripts.translation:
{0}
看到一堆东西时，我就忍不住想用四只爪子跳上去。

scripts.text:
{0}
I must have been a cat in my previous life.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我前世一定是一只猫。

scripts.text:
{0}
I dreamt about the giant again. I waved my paws annoyed and he kept on patting me.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我又梦到那个巨人了。我烦躁地挥动爪子，他却一直抚摸我。

scripts.text:
{0}
Yup!! Was the rumor true that Ahat looks like a human?!
scripts.translation:
{0}
没错！！阿哈特长得像人类的传闻是真的吗？！

scripts.text:
{0}
I heard on my way that this Pinqucula Dark has a Withered Flower.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我在路上听说这只捕虫堇黑暗拥有凋谢的花。

scripts.text:
{0}
There is a guy named Pinguicula nearby who has the Sharp Leaf nearby.
scripts.translation:
{0}
附近有一个叫捕虫堇的家伙，身上有尖锐的叶子。

scripts.text:
{0}
There is a guy named Pinguicula nearby who has the Great Leaf nearby.
scripts.translation:
{0}
附近有一个叫捕虫堇的家伙，身上有大叶子。

scripts.text:
{0}
I recommend getting it from the Dracos nearby. But then, they only drop it randomly so you may come back empty handed...
scripts.translation:
{0}
我建议你去附近的飞龙那里获取。不过，它们只是随机掉落，你可能会空手而归...

scripts.text:
{0}
Hmm... This may not be important to you but.
scripts.translation:
{0}
嗯...这对您来说可能并不重要，但是。

scripts.text:
{0}
Oh... no luck on Sapha Certifications?
scripts.translation:
{0}
噢...没拿到沙帕功勋证吗？

scripts.text:
{0}
If you work hard in this city, you will get an Exploit Certification of Sapha.
scripts.translation:
{0}
如果您在这座城市努力工作，就能获得沙帕功勋证。

scripts.text:
{0}
I've been gathering exploit certifications of Sapha for a year now to meet Ahat.
scripts.translation:
{0}
为了见到阿哈特，我已经收集沙帕功勋证一年了。

scripts.text:
{0}
Do you want to look luxurious with Golden Bells?
scripts.translation:
{0}
您想用宠物铃铛来炫耀一下吗？

scripts.text:
{0}
You must be interested in the ^800080Feral Tail^000000?
scripts.translation:
{0}
您一定对^800080狂野尾巴^000000很感兴趣吧？

scripts.text:
{0}
You've come for Feral Boots. I have just the item for you.
scripts.translation:
{0}
您是来买狂野长靴的。我正好有您要的东西。

scripts.text:
{0}
So you haven't got any...
scripts.translation:
{0}
看来您还没有...

scripts.text:
{0}
That's sad. They're very are useful, you know...
scripts.translation:
{0}
真遗憾。它们其实很有用的，您知道吗...

scripts.text:
{0}
If you do come across one of the certifications, can you bring it to me?
scripts.translation:
{0}
如果您找到了沙帕功勋证，能带给我吗？

scripts.text:
{0}
We can make an exchange and you won't regret it.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我们可以做个交换，您绝对不会后悔的。

scripts.text:
{0}
But I'm far from it because it takes a high position and some bribery for a low creature like me to meet him.
scripts.translation:
{0}
但我离那还很远。像我这种低等生物，想要见他，需要很高的职位，还得行贿才行。

scripts.text:
{0}
If you have any exploit certifications of Sapha to spare, please share them with me. I promise to pay you back in services. You'll never get anywhere else.
scripts.translation:
{0}
如果您有多余的沙帕功勋证，请分给我一些。我保证用服务来回报您。您在别处绝对找不到这样的待遇。

scripts.text: Please explain.
scripts.translation: 请解释一下。

scripts.text: I want to reset.
scripts.translation: 我想重置

scripts.text: I want to upgrade.
scripts.translation: 我想强化它。

scripts.text:
{0}
Hmm. The ^990099Golden Bell^000000 is an accessory awarded to only the best and bravest warriors among our people.
scripts.translation:
{0}
嗯。^990099宠物铃铛^000000是只授予我们族中最优秀、最勇敢的战士的饰品。

scripts.text:
{0}
A random skill is casted up to the first and second steps but
scripts.translation:
{0}
随机技能可以强化到第一和第二级，但是

scripts.text:
{0}
There is a risk of the item breaking during the third upgrade.
scripts.translation:
{0}
在第三级强化时，物品有损坏的风险。

scripts.text:
{0}
You say you want me to explain about upgrade?
scripts.translation:
{0}
您说想让我解释一下强化的事？

scripts.text:
{0}
Hmm. The ^990099Feral Tail^000000 is an unique item. It looks just like our tails.
scripts.translation:
{0}
嗯。^990099狂野尾巴^000000是一件独特的物品。它看起来就像我们的尾巴。

scripts.text:
{0}
It is not only strong and warm but is also powerful enough to be enchanted with magical spells.
scripts.translation:
{0}
它不仅坚固保暖，而且足够强大，可以附魔多种魔法。

scripts.text:
[Mancho]
Well... it comes with the same risks as the ^990099Feral Boots^000000 of breaking at the third step of upgrade.
scripts.translation:
[曼乔]
嗯...它和^990099狂野长靴^000000一样，在第三级强化时也有损坏的风险。

scripts.text:
{0}
You say you want me to explain about upgrade?
scripts.translation:
{0}
您说想让我解释一下强化的事？

scripts.text:
{0}
Hmm. The ^990099Feral Boots^000000 are very unique. A shoemaker took the design of our feet and designed this item long ago.
scripts.translation:
{0}
嗯。^990099狂野长靴^000000非常独特。很久以前，一位鞋匠参考了我们脚的设计，制作了这件物品。

scripts.text:
{0}
I do not know the actual materials used but they are strong enough to enchant up to 3 kinds of upgrade magic spells.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我不知道具体用了什么材料，但它们足够坚固，可以附魔多达3种强化魔法。

scripts.text:
{0}
Well... some do get broken at the third upgrade and I do have some customers complaining when that happens.......meow
scripts.translation:
{0}
嗯...有些在第三级强化时确实会损坏，我也有一些顾客在那时抱怨过.......喵

scripts.text:
{0}
... I almost died in one occasion. (murmuring)
scripts.translation:
{0}
...有一次我差点死了。（低声说）

scripts.text: Maybe next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再说

scripts.text: Please reset it.
scripts.translation: 请重置它

scripts.text:
{0}
Then, take the equipment off first.
scripts.translation:
{0}
那么，请先取下装备。

scripts.text:
{0}
I've collected all equipment and erased all records as you requested. Now all your equipment and records are clean.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我已按您的要求收集了所有装备并删除了所有记录。现在您的装备和记录都已清理干净。

scripts.text:
{0}
I only do what I'm asked to do. I've retrieved all equipment and cancelled all records.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我只是照做而已。我已取回所有装备并取消了所有记录。

scripts.text:
{0}
I'm preparing for the
first step of upgrade.
Once equipment is upgraded
you cannot change the upgrade
before you destroy it.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我正在准备第一步强化。
一旦装备被强化，
在销毁之前无法更改强化状态。

scripts.text:
{0}
First upgrade step requires ^8000801 Sapha Certification^000000. Do you want to proceed?
scripts.translation:
{0}
第一步强化需要^8000801 沙帕功勋证^000000。您要继续吗？

scripts.text:
{0}
I'm preparing for the
second step of upgrade.
Once equipment is upgraded
you cannot change the upgrade
before you destroy it.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我正在准备第二步强化。
一旦装备被强化，
在销毁之前无法更改强化状态。

scripts.text:
{0}
Second upgrade step requires ^9900992 Exploit Certifications of Sapha^000000. Do you want to proceed?
scripts.translation:
{0}
第二步强化需要^9900992 沙帕功勋证^000000。您要继续吗？

scripts.text:
{0}
I'm preparing for the
third step of upgrade.
Once equipment is upgraded
you cannot change the upgrade
before you destroy it.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我正在准备第三步强化。
一旦装备被强化，
在销毁之前无法更改强化状态。

scripts.text:
{0}
And this is the most important,
the risk of equipment to break
during the third upgrade step is high!
And you need ^9900993 Exploit Certifications of Sapha^000000 for the procedure.
scripts.translation:
{0}
这是最重要的一步，
第三步强化时装备损坏的风险很高！
并且您需要^9900993 沙帕功勋证^000000来进行此操作。

scripts.text:
{0}
Please keep in mind that
this is a delicate process of
casting immense power to the equipment.
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
{0}
请记住，
这是一个向装备注入巨大魔力的精细过程。
您准备好了吗？

{0}
您已完成第三步强化。

scripts.text:
{0}
If you do not like
your equipment upgrade
I can withdraw your equipment
and destroy all records
of it
scripts.translation:
{0}
如果您不喜欢
您的装备强化结果，
我可以取回您的装备
并销毁所有相关记录

scripts.text: I'll just use it.
scripts.translation: 我就这样用

scripts.text: Please take it.
scripts.translation: 请取回

scripts.text:
{0}
I have erased all previous records
of upgrades to start all over with
any new equipment without upgrades
you bring.
Maybe next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再说

scripts.text: I want to upgrade.
scripts.translation: 我想强化它。

scripts.text:
{0}
But you don't have enough exploit certifications. You need {1} exploit certification of Sapha for the {2} step of upgrade.
scripts.translation:
{0}
但是您的功勋证数量不足。进行第{2}步强化需要{1}张沙帕功勋证。

scripts.text:
{0}
Then let's start.
scripts.translation:
{0}
那么，我们开始吧。

scripts.text:
{0}
Ha ha ha. See, I told you. Oops, sorry. Forget that I just said that!!
scripts.translation:
{0}
哈哈哈哈哈。看吧，我早就告诉过你的。哎呀，抱歉。请忘掉我刚才说的话！！

scripts.text:
{0}
Greed is the reason for failing investments. Tsk, tsk.
scripts.translation:
{0}
贪婪是投资失败的原因。啧啧。

scripts.text:
{0}
Oh no....!!!! What happened to the Golden Bell!
scripts.translation:
{0}
天哪....！！宠物铃铛怎么了！

scripts.text:
{0}
I'm done. Hehe
scripts.translation:
{0}
完成了。嘿嘿

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
You haven't received a Sapha Certification yet?
scripts.translation:
[贾邦]
您还没有获得沙帕功勋证吗？

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Don't touch my back! I might bite you unconsciously.
scripts.translation:
[贾邦]
别摸我的背！我可能会在不知不觉中咬你。

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Pub owner Shay carried something away to make something strange! Be careful!
scripts.translation:
[贾邦]
酒馆老板谢伊拿走了什么东西去搞什么奇怪的东西！小心点！

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
We cats can jump 5 times our size. Isn't it cool? But then, don't ask me to jump from here now.
scripts.translation:
[贾邦]
我们猫可以跳到自身体型5倍的高度。是不是很酷？不过，别让我现在从这里跳下去。

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
I have to be diligent with my grooming to maintain beautiful fur.
scripts.translation:
[贾邦]
我必须勤快地舔毛，才能保持美丽的毛发。

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
I have to groom myself everyday to maintain shiny fluffy fur. But I don't have very nice fur in the first place. Very sad.
scripts.translation:
[贾邦]
我必须每天梳理毛发，才能保持光亮蓬松。但我原本的毛发就不怎么好。真伤心。

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
You should receive a Sapha Certification with both paws as a sign of respect. No cat deserves a certification if they don't!
scripts.translation:
[贾邦]
你应该用双爪接过沙帕功勋证，以示尊重。如果不这样做，就不配拥有功勋证。

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
I don't really talk that much! Ahat looks like... meow meow meooow... sorry.
scripts.translation:
[贾邦]
我其实不太爱说话！阿哈特看起来像...喵喵喵呜...抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Meow~~~~~~~~~~

[Jahbong]
Yarn is a great way to calm a cat.
scripts.translation:
[贾邦]
毛线是安抚猫咪的好方法。

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Come back to me once you have one. I'll give you something good in exchange.
scripts.translation:
[贾邦]
拿到一个之后回来找我。我会给你一些好东西作为交换。

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Why are you here?
Jahbong will exchange ^8000801 Sapha Certification^000000 for ^8000801 item^000000!
scripts.translation:
[贾邦]
你来这里做什么？
贾邦可以用^8000801 1个沙帕功勋证^000000交换^8000801 1个物品^000000！

scripts.text: Just came to see what you have.
scripts.translation: 只是来看看你有什么。

scripts.text: I want the Feral Boots!
scripts.translation: 我要狂野长靴！

scripts.text: Give me the Feral Tail!
scripts.translation: 给我狂野尾巴！

scripts.text: Give me the Golden Bell!
scripts.translation: 给我宠物铃铛！

scripts.text: How much to buy you?
scripts.translation: 买你多少钱？

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Meow!
scripts.translation:
[贾邦]
喵！

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
^8000801Feral Boots^000000 are shoes for your feet! Buy one and Jalapeno over there will refine it for you!
scripts.translation:
[贾邦]
^8000801狂野长靴^000000是穿在脚上的鞋子！买一双，那边的哈拉佩诺可以帮你精炼！

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
^8000801Feral Tail^000000 is pretty rough! Mancho over there can help you fix it!!
scripts.translation:
[贾邦]
^8000801狂野尾巴^000000有点粗糙！那边的曼乔可以帮你修理！！

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
^8000801Golden Bell^000000 is an accessory. Brare spent 40 years making this! Or maybe 4 years! Oh well, come back when you need anything!
scripts.translation:
[贾邦]
^8000801宠物铃铛^000000是饰品。布拉尔花了40年制作这个！或者可能是4年！总之，有需要随时回来！

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
There are some crazy adventurers asking if they can purchase me! Jahbong is not for sale! I'll just bite you if you ask!!
scripts.translation:
[贾邦]
有些疯狂的冒险者问能不能买我！贾邦不是用来卖的！如果你再问，我就咬你！！

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Meooooooooooow!!!!!!!!~~ Meooooooooow!!!!!
- ^800080Jahbong goes wild^000000. -

[Jahbong]
I'm not an item!! I will not be merciful if you treat me like one!!
scripts.translation:
[贾邦]
我不是物品！！如果你把我当物品对待，我绝不会心软的！！

scripts.text: - He may react extremely, but Jahbong doesn't seem to be really angry. -
scripts.translation: - 他的反应很激烈，但贾邦似乎并没有真的生气。-

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Are you really buying something?!
scripts.translation:
[贾邦]
你真的要买点什么吗？！

scripts.text: Nope
scripts.translation: 没有

scripts.text: Give me!!!
scripts.translation: 给我！！！

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Okay!
scripts.translation:
[贾邦]
好吧！

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Here you go!
scripts.translation:
[贾邦]
给你！

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
Hey, human! Did you come to make a request, too? When will it be my turn?
scripts.translation:
[猫爪特工]
嘿，人类！你也是来提交委托的吗？什么时候才轮到我啊？

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
Our Cat Paw Merchant group really needs any help it can get. But by the looks of all those requests that Ebenor is holding in his hand, Cat Paw Merchant will be closed by the time my request is put up on the board!
scripts.translation:
[猫爪特工]
我们猫爪商团真的很需要任何帮助。但看埃贝诺尔手里拿着的那些委托，等我的委托挂到公告板上时，猫爪商团都要关门了！

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
It breaks my heart to think my colleagues will be shivering in the blizzard. I hope I don't get into trouble since I can't do anything about it, right?
scripts.translation:
[猫爪特工]
想到我的同事们在暴风雪中瑟瑟发抖，我的心都碎了。希望我不会因为无能为力而惹上麻烦，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
Hey, human! Did you come to make a request, too? When will it be my turn?
scripts.translation:
[猫爪特工]
嘿，人类！你也是来提交委托的吗？什么时候才轮到我啊？

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
Our Cat Paw Merchant group really needs any help it can get. But by the looks of all those requests that Ebenor is holding in his hand, Cat Paw Merchant will be closed by the time my request is put up on the board!
scripts.translation:
[猫爪特工]
我们猫爪商团真的很需要任何帮助。但看埃贝诺尔手里拿着的那些委托，等我的委托挂到公告板上时，猫爪商团都要关门了！

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
It breaks my heart to think my colleagues will be shivering in the blizzard. I hope I don't get into trouble since I can't do anything about it, right?
scripts.translation:
[猫爪特工]
想到我的同事们在暴风雪中瑟瑟发抖，我的心都碎了。希望我不会因为无能为力而惹上麻烦，对吧？

scripts.text: Why don't you collect it yourself?
scripts.translation: 你自己去收集吧

scripts.text: I'm sorry to hear that.
scripts.translation: 听到这个我很遗憾。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
Human!! You're a genius!!
How did you come up with that?
scripts.translation:
[猫爪特工]
人类！！你真是个天才！！
你是怎么想到这个主意的？

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
I'm Agent Geck from the Cat Paw Merchant.
Car Paw Merchant has been wandering for a long time in this Midgard world ever since we lost our homeland.
scripts.translation:
[特工 盖克]
我是猫爪商团的特工盖克。
自从失去家园以来，猫爪商团一直在米德加尔特这个世界流浪了很久。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
But now we realize there is no place for our group here in Midgard.
Geck, Gyareuk and Gorureung did a lot of thinking about it.
scripts.translation:
[特工 盖克]
但现在我们意识到，在米德加尔特没有我们商团的位置。
盖克、吉亚鲁克和戈鲁伦为此思考了很久。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
But we finally found a place to settle!
It may be a bit cold but there are no Kafra or Jonda there!
We will gain ground in our new land!
scripts.translation:
[特工 盖克]
但我们终于找到了安身之地！
那里可能有点冷，但没有卡普拉或琼达！
我们将在新的土地上站稳脚跟！

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
But of course, we don't have any influence over there to start with.
However, we plan to spare no efforts on it.
scripts.translation:
[特工 盖克]
但当然，我们在那里起初没有任何影响力。
不过，我们计划不遗余力地去开拓。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Human!! Did you know there is a huge hole near the Morocc village and nearby area?
They say you can travel to a new area through the hole!
scripts.translation:
[特工 盖克]
人类！！你知道莫洛村附近有一个巨大的洞吗？
据说可以通过那个洞前往一个新的区域！

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
But you will have to go through tests and research to get to a place before trying it out.
To me, I think its all nonsense to go through the trouble!
scripts.translation:
[特工 盖克]
但你需要通过测试和研究才能到达那里，然后再尝试过去。
对我来说，我觉得费这么大劲去折腾完全是胡扯！

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
We must send someone as soon as possible to start exploring the area.
While the humans are frittering away, our Cat Paw Merchant should settle first and continue with our research.
scripts.translation:
[特工 盖克]
我们必须尽快派人去探索那个区域。
当人类还在虚度光阴时，我们猫爪商团应该先安顿下来并继续我们的研究。

scripts.text: I also want to go and help the merchants.
scripts.translation: 我也想去帮助商人们

scripts.text: I'm not interested.
scripts.translation: 我不感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
You are better than other humans!
If you really mean it, then sign here.
I'm collecting signs to get on Gyareuk's good side... never mind. I will let them know you are my sponsor!
scripts.translation:
[特工 盖克]
你比其他人类强多了！
如果你是真的这么想的，那就在这里签字吧。
我正在收集签名以讨好吉亚鲁克...算了。我会让他们知道你是我的赞助人！

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
{0}? Human names are strange to me.
scripts.translation:
[特工 盖克]
{0}？人类的名字对我来说很奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Now you are Geck's personal slav... sponsor.
Don't ask why you aren't Merchant sponsor.
A good human does not poke around where they are not supposed to.
scripts.translation:
[特工 盖克]
现在你是盖克的私人奴...赞助人。
别问为什么你不是商团的赞助人。
一个好人不会去窥探不该窥探的地方。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Now since you've signed, all we need to do is leave for the other world.
I heard humans call it Ash-Vacuum.
Nobody explained to Geck why it was called that.
scripts.translation:
[特工 盖克]
既然你已经签了字，我们只需要前往另一个世界。
我听说人类称之为“艾什真空”。
没有人向盖克解释过为什么叫这个名字。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
But human.
You will need to pay to get to the Ash-Vacuum.
There wouldn't be any expense for Geck to send you there myself but we must ask for help from other agents.
scripts.translation:
[特工 盖克]
但是人类。
你需要付费才能到达艾什真空。
盖克亲自送你过去不需要任何费用，但我们必须请求其他特工的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
So you will need some money to buy fish for agents who help you.
I will introduce you to an agent who will send you to the other world with no questions asked for only 50,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[特工 盖克]
所以你需要一些钱来买鱼给那些帮助你的特工。
我会介绍一位特工给你，他只要50,000 Zeny就会不问缘由地送你到另一个世界。

scripts.text: Pay 50,000 zeny.
scripts.translation: 支付50,000 Zeny

scripts.text: No way!
scripts.translation: 绝对不行！

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Geck learned not to deal with people who can't pay.
scripts.translation:
[特工 盖克]
盖克学会了不与付不起钱的人打交道。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
With this, our contract is now complete.
Geck will help you to get to Ash-Vacuum in one piece.
scripts.translation:
[特工 盖克]
至此，我们的契约已经完成。
盖克会帮你完好无损地抵达艾什真空。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Don't forget, human. The reason why Geck is helping you is to help the Cat Paw Merchant working hard in the other world.
scripts.translation:
[特工 盖克]
别忘了，人类。盖克帮助你，是为了帮助在另一个世界辛勤工作的猫爪商人。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Now, I will transport you. Go meet our agent in the right corner.
scripts.translation:
[特工 盖克]
现在，我要传送你了。去见见右下角的那位特工吧。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Geck doesn't force humans.
But I think you will change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[特工 盖克]
盖克不会强迫人类。
但我认为你会改变主意的。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Did you meet the Cat Paw Merchant in Ash-Vacuum, human?
scripts.translation:
[特工 盖克]
你见到艾什真空的猫爪商人了吗，人类？

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
But our Cat Paw Merchant will overcome any obstacle!
scripts.translation:
[猫爪特工]
但我们的猫爪商人会克服任何障碍！

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Did you meet the Cat Paw Merchant in Ash-Vacuum, human?
scripts.translation:
[特工 盖克]
你见到艾什真空的猫爪商人了吗，人类？

scripts.text: Send me back
scripts.translation: 送我回去

scripts.text: I'm busy
scripts.translation: 我很忙

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
There is no time to waste, human!
I'll send you back right away!
scripts.translation:
[特工 盖克]
没有时间浪费了，人类！
我马上送你回去！

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Hey, human! Didn't you say you will help the Cat Paw Merchant!
scripts.translation:
[特工 盖克]
嘿，人类！你不是说要帮助猫爪商人吗！

scripts.text:
[Cat]
Meow~
scripts.translation:
[猫]
喵~

scripts.text:
A small Cat Paw Agent looks at you and nods its head towards the back.
Looks like it wants you to step up on its back to climb over the wall.
scripts.translation:
一只小小的猫爪特工看着你，并朝后方点了点头。
看来它想让你踩在它的背上翻过墙去。

scripts.text: But you are so cute...
scripts.translation: 可是你好可爱...

scripts.text: Let's do this!
scripts.translation: 让我们开始吧！

scripts.text: The small Cat Paw Agent has small black patterns as if it were stamped on it's white fur.
scripts.translation: 这只小小的猫爪特工身上有黑色的花纹，像是印在它白色的毛发上一样。

scripts.text: The small body isn't as tall as your ankle and its small but thick paws look like little cushions. The ears that bent backwards when it looked at how big you were stirred up your protective instinct.
scripts.translation: 它小小的身体甚至不到你的脚踝高，那小而厚实的爪子看起来像小垫子。当它抬头看你有多高大时，向后耷拉的耳朵激发了你的保护欲。

scripts.text: You don't seem to have the nerve to step on the Cat Paw Agent.
scripts.translation: 你似乎没有勇气踩在猫爪特工身上。

scripts.text: You look at the Cat Paw Agent's small back and climb over the wall as quick as possible so that it wouldn't notice your weight.
scripts.translation: 你看着猫爪特工小小的背影，尽可能快地翻过墙去，以免它察觉到你的重量。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
This place as no meaning for us.
scripts.translation:
[猫爪特工]
这个地方对我们没有意义。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
Heard from Geck.
I'm the Cat Paw Merchant's rising star, Tat.
scripts.translation:
[猫爪特工]
听盖克说。
我是猫爪商人的新星，塔特。

scripts.text:
[Tat]
I heard you are offering high-quality fish to pay for our passage.
I also heard the fish is very fresh and has shiny golden scales.
scripts.translation:
[塔特]
我听说你愿意提供高品质的鱼来支付我们的通行费。
我还听说那些鱼非常新鲜，而且有着闪闪发光的金色鳞片。

scripts.text:
[Tat]
I usually only allow our Cat Paw Merchant agents to go through but since you are here on Geck's behalf and seeing you are reliable, I'll let you through.
scripts.translation:
[塔特]
通常我只允许猫爪商人的特工通过，但既然你是代表盖克来的，而且看起来也很可靠，我就放你过去吧。

scripts.text:
[Tat]
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[塔特]
你准备好了吗？

scripts.text: To the other world!
scripts.translation: 前往另一个世界

scripts.text: I need some time.
scripts.translation: 我还需要一点时间

scripts.text:
[Tat]
Don't forget you are in debt to the Cat Paw Merchant, human!
scripts.translation:
[塔特]
别忘了，人类，你欠着猫爪商人的债呢！

scripts.text:
[Tat]
Aren't you suppose to be done getting ready before you come here?
scripts.translation:
[塔特]
难道你不应该在准备好之前再来这里吗？
